jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

  

  

  

  

**Mohave County Public Works department is looking to fill the position of an Office Assistant**  

The mission of Mohave County Public Works is to serve its citizens through the delivery of quality public works services through efficient use of resources in a manner that enhances the lives of those served. **About the Position**


This position provides administrative and clerical support in an office environment. Responsibilities include answering phones, assisting customers and the public, preparing documents, maintaining records, coordinating tasks, gathering information and documents, and performing a variety of general clerical duties.


The position requires frequent interaction with County staff, other departments, outside agencies, and members of the public. The successful candidate will provide accurate and timely information, respond to inquiries, coordinate administrative activities, and maintain a professional and customer\-focused approach.

**Work Schedule:** Monday through Friday.

**Compensation**  

**Range 6/Steps 2\-8 ($15\.45\-$18\.45\)** **Proud to Offer****Paid Time Off (PTO)****:*** 11 Paid Holidays.
* End of Year PTO Buyback (optional).

 **Retirement Benefits****:*** Enrollment in Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS).
	+ Contribution rate of 11\.98% with 100% Employer match starting on first day.
* Deferred Compensations Programs (optional)

 **Comprehensive Wellness Program****:*** Low\-cost, high\-value health care plans for you and your family that include Medical, Dental, Vision.
* 24/7 Virtual Care including Onsite Health Screening Events
* Marketplace Discounts
* Onsite Gyms or Gym Membership Stipend
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee Wellness Program
* Basic Life, Supplemental Life/AD\&D Insurances with additional voluntary benefits include Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Plans.
* Health Savings Account (HSA) or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA\-includes Dependent Care).
* **Must pass pre\-employment background screening.**
  


**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------


Duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:* Meets and greets the public.
* Receives phone calls and responds to questions concerning department procedures or directs query to an individual or department as appropriate.
* May talk with individuals to gather preliminary information or verify information for various County programs or activities.
* As requested, review work of other staff for conformance to regulations.
* Understands and interprets procedures and practices related to various departmental and assigned programs.
* Assists an office superior by performing routine administrative details including but not limited to: sorting and routing department mail, making copies, scanning documents, filing, alphabetizing documents and date stamping incoming documents, maintaining waiting lists for services, maintain program specific databases and spreadsheets.
* Contacts vendors to obtain prices and purchases various supplies and materials.
* Maintains and establishes associated files to include entering information and documents into filing and data systems ensuring completeness and accuracy.
* Types forms, letters, reports and file cards from draft, or rough copy.
* Prepares follow\-up correspondence or calls to obtain additional information or to respond to inquiries.
* Prepares standardized reports and statements.
* Processes payments in the database.
* Records attendance and documents notes at required meetings.
* Collects, compiles and submits data for use in statistical reports, internal operating studies or policy formulation.
* Meets established deadlines and informs concerned parties of deadlines and appointments.
* Maintains an inventory of materials on\-hand and notifies the supervisor when supplies are needed. May order supplies as required.
* Maintain a high level of confidentiality of information.
* Present and conduct themselves in a professional manner at all times.
* Communicate in a courteous and helpful manner as well as clear and concise manner at all times.
* Resolve complaints within scope of information and authority, and/or refer to chain\-of\-command as appropriate.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* High School diploma/ GED (General Education Degree).
* Two (2\) years minimum of progressive office support and clerical training.
* An equivalent combination of education, experience, and training which provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities may be considered in meeting the minimum qualifications.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
----------------------------------


**Knowledge of:*** Modern office practices and records management/maintenance procedures.
* English grammar and spelling.
* Basic mathematics required to calculate and perform general accounting procedures.
* Filing and information systems, including EXCEL spreadsheets and Microsoft Word.
* Mohave County Personnel Policies \& Procedures and Department Regulations.

**Skill in:**

* Effectively operating personal computers, calculators and peripheral hardware and software products to provide guidance on the maintenance and implementation of developmental procedures of department to which assigned.

**Ability to:**

* Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing with all people.
* Use databases and other forms of electronic data storage.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records and documentation.
* Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.
* Obtain data from the computer during on\-line operations, including interpreting technical and departmental information encountered in the performance of responsibilities.
* Maintain a high standard of confidentiality.
* Understand brief, written or oral directions and grasp ideas quickly in order to carry out instructions, solve problems with initiative and exercise good judgment.
* Organize workload to ensure determinations are made on a time basis.
* Act in a professional manner and professional in communication with others.
* Comply with Mohave County Personnel Policies \& Procedures and Department Regulations.
* Perform the essential functions of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.

\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*

This is a direct care position focusing on assisting brain injured clients in physical restoration, cognitive restoration, behavioral difficulties, nursing needs, recreational needs as well as other activities of daily living. Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.* **Client Services Delivery**
* Reports information regarding client functioning to shift supervisor and Program RN.
* Demonstrates competency in the implementation of the treatment plan through completion of scheduled client activities.
* Participates in behavior modification programs by promoting socially acceptable behavior, using appropriate intervention and documentation.
* Participates in specialized aspects of patient care, within the scope of skill and training under the supervision of the Program RN.
* Works directly with assigned clients in order to achieve treatment objectives.
* Completes accurate records to ensure correct documentation in the appropriate timeframes according to policies and procedures.
* Demonstrates responsibility for own personal growth by participating in staff meetings and inservice educational activities and participating in client staffing as requested.
* Competently completes all aspects of patient care including age appropriate techniques for ADLs, mobility, transfers, hygiene, toileting, bathing/showering, hair cutting, recreational activities, and use of adaptive devices.
* As a team member, participates in the daily staff assignments such as: client activities/outings, meal preparation according to dietary guidelines, patient feeding, laundry, supply ordering, grocery shopping, client rounds, bed changes, and patient bathing.
* Follows all polices governing use of company vehicles and transporting of PAM Health’s clients.
* Follows the policies and procedures of PAM Health and the Brain Injury Program.

* **Customer Service**
* Maintains the highest level of customer service via courtesy, compassion and positive communication.
* Promotes the mission and vision of PAM Health within the work environment and the community.
* Respects dignity and confidentiality by adherence to all applicable policies and procedures.

* **Health and Safety**
* Works in a manner that promotes safety; wears clothing appropriate to the performance of the job.
* Participates in OSHA required training.
* Follows universal precautions as appropriate for position; complies with Employee Health requirements for continued employment.
* Reports unsafe practices to management.
* Knows own role in case of an emergency.

 **Education and Training:** High school diploma/GED.

**Experience:** College credit hours related to brain injury, rehabilitation or other human services courses preferred. Interest in neurologic rehabilitation preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* May work with various hand tools including drill, saw, hammer, and electric sander.
* Will at times need to use tape measures and other measuring tools.
* May be requested to operate other equipment and/or perform duties not related to position (i.e., operate motor vehicle for client transport) at the discretion of supervisor.

jobs.description:
**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living while reducing emissions. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

**About Houston**
-----------------


ExxonMobil's state\-of\-the\-art campus north of Houston serves as home to its Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses and their associated service groups. The facility opened in 2014 and accommodates more than 10,000 employees and visitors.

  

By bringing many global functional groups together, the campus provides employees with the tools and capabilities needed today, and in the future, to achieve business objectives and accelerate the discovery of new resources, technologies and products. It was designed to foster improved collaboration, creativity and innovation and enhance the company’s ability to attract, develop and retain the top talent in the industry.

  

The campus is located in Spring, Texas, on 385 wooded acres immediately to the west of Interstate Highway 45 (I\-45\), at the intersection of I\-45 and the Hardy Toll Road, approximately 25 miles from the cultural vibrancy of downtown Houston

  

The campus was constructed to the highest standards of energy efficiency and environmental stewardship. Its design incorporates extensive research into best practices in building and workplace design through extensive benchmarking of the world’s top academic, research, and corporate facilities.

  

Learn more about what we do in Houston**here**.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


We are seeking a highly experienced and forward\-thinking Business Development Manager to lead the development and execution of opportunities in the new business area of Carbon Products for ExxonMobil. This role combines deep domain expertise, innovation leadership, and operational excellence to develop new business model opportunities and relationships with potential customers.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Develop and build the business models necessary to drive success in the Carbon\-rich Products space. Carbon\-rich Products includes all products in the carbon value chain.
* Execute complex agreements from inception to conclusion and advise on complex global issues
* Design key elements of complex agreements to manage commercial / geopolitical / regulatory and other risks while maximizing value
* Lead high value / complex / multi\-party negotiations with counterparties and Governments as appropriate
* Lead alignment of internal stakeholders to define corporate external positions to maximize value
* Create and execute complex external influence plans and internal persuasive narratives to support strategy implementation within specific tasks
* Develop key external networks and build appropriate relationships to identify value opportunities
**About you**
-------------

*Preferred Qualifications and Experience:*

* B.S. degree in Business, Engineering, Industrial Technology, or related field
* 10\+ years commercial experience in the commercial experience in the carbon value chain
* Broad market development capability with leadership experience in developing and / or executing in new business spaces
* Trained in research competencies
* Business model design experience, including technology licensing models
* Global relationship development experience

 *Unique aptitudes:*

* Creative, unconstrained clear thinker
* Motivating and inspiring, passionate about creating new opportunities
* A recognized business entrepreneur – able to see business value in new concepts outside of the base businesses comfort zone, translates new ideas into a clear vision, develop a compelling narrative to explains new areas of competitive advantage and value capture
* Exudes courage of conviction
* Comfortable developing relationships with atypical business partners and counter parties
* Loves new technology, but is more excited by new businesses, markets and the possibility of deploying new technologies to grow the business
**Your benefits**
-----------------


An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance, and life.

 **We offer you:**

* Pension Plan: Enrollment is automatic and at no cost to you. The basic benefit is a monthly annuity to be paid to you in retirement for the rest of your life
* Savings Plan: You can contribute between 6% and 20% of your pay and are encouraged to enroll right away. If you contribute at least 6% to your savings plan, the Company will contribute a 7% match
* Workplace Flexibility: We have several programs such as “Flex your Day”, providing ad\-hoc flexibility around when and where you work, as well as longer\-term programs such as leaves of absence and part\-time work
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
* Culture of Health: Programs and resources to support your wellbeing
* Employee Health Advisory Program: Provides confidential professional counseling for you and your family, including tools and resources promoting mental health and resiliency at no additional cost to you
* Disability Plan: Income replacement for when you cannot work due to illness or injury occurring on or off the job. Enrollment is automatic and at no cost to you

  

More information on our Company’s benefits can be found at www.exxonmobilfamily.com

  

Please note benefits may be changed from time to time without notice, subject to applicable law.

**Stay connected with us**
--------------------------


Learn more at our **website**  

Follow us on **LinkedIn** and **Instagram**  

Like us on **Facebook**  

Subscribe our channel at **YouTube**

  

Alternate Location:

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner, Allied Recruiting
jobs.description:
At ConvenientMD, we're on a mission to make good health more convenient for all – working to improve how patients and providers experience healthcare in New England. To support this belief, we're building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

### **The Opportunity**



Are you looking to grow your career in recruitment or transition into a new role within healthcare? This role is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their recruitment career or a professional with healthcare knowledge/experience who is excited to step into a recruiting role. You will play a key part in sourcing, attracting, and hiring allied healthcare professionals, including medical assistants, registered nurses, radiologic technologists, and other clinical support roles, for our urgent care clinics across New England. This hands\-on role will provide you with valuable experience in full\-cycle recruitment while offering mentorship and collaboration with experienced teams across Operations, Human Resources, and Medical Leadership.


### **Your Impact**


* **Manage Day\-to\-Day Recruiting \& Candidate Experience:** Identify, evaluate, and hire best\-in\-class providers within agree upon timelines.
	+ Identify and engage with potential candidates through proactive outreach and relationship\-building. Utilize various sourcing methods, including job boards, social media, networking, and industry events.
	+ Review inbound applications within 48 hours of application.
	+ Coordinate and conduct interviews, both in\-person and virtual, with candidates and hiring managers.
	+ Conduct thorough screenings and assessments to ensure candidates meet the required qualifications, licensure, and fit with our organizational culture.
	+ Assist hiring managers in making informed hiring decisions by providing detailed candidate assessments and recommendations.
	+ Provide a positive candidate experience throughout the entire interview process (from application to onboarding) by responding to candidate applications and questions quickly and keeping candidates apprised of decisions made about their application.
	+ Successfully present and negotiate offers. Truthfully and thoughtfully sell ConvenientMD's (CMD) benefits and growth opportunities to candidates.
	+ Collect and check references in a professional and timely manner.
* **Partner with Internal Teams:** Collaborate with practice managers and regional directors of operations to understand staffing needs and priorities.
	+ Build trust with internal stakeholders by providing clear, regular updates on recruitment progress.
	+ Support with the development of marketing materials that highlight allied healthcare roles and benefits at CMD.
* **Data \& Organization:**
	+ Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate records in the applicant tracking system (ATS).
	+ Track and report on recruitment activities and performance to ensure goals are being met.
* **Pipeline Development \& Partnerships:**
	+ Proactively develop and maintain relationships with technical schools, training programs, and professional organizations to build a pipeline of candidates.
	+ Attend recruitment events and virtual networking opportunities to promote CMD as an employer of choice.
* **Onboarding Support:** Assist with the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition and positive experience.
* **Miscellaneous Team \& Project Support:** When needed, provide support to other recruiters overseeing both allied, provider, and corporate roles as well as support on various projects overtime.

### **Who You Are**


* ***Experience in similar roles:*** 2\+ years of recruitment experience, ideally in allied health or clinical roles. Prior experience recruiting medical assistants, registered nurses, radiologic technologists, or similar roles is preferred.
* ***Effective*** ***communicator:***Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build trust with candidates and hiring managers.
* ***Organized and detail\-oriented:***Ability to manage multiple roles and tasks simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.
* ***Proactive and resourceful:*** Willing to think outside the box to identify and engage candidates. Comfortable sourcing passive candidates and using creative recruitment strategies.
* ***Collaborative partner:***A team player who builds strong relationships with hiring managers and works effectively across departments.
* ***Technically savvy:*** Experience with Microsoft Office, specifically SharePoint, Word, and Excel. Proficiency in using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other recruitment technologies/sourcing platforms is preferred.
* ***Mission\-driven:***Passion for recruiting top talent to support CMD's mission of delivering high\-quality care to patients.
* ***Trustworthy:*** Maintains confidentiality and handles all candidate information with discretion. Able to accurately and honestly sell ConvenientMD and its offerings to candidates.

#### **Why You'll Love Working With Us**


* Collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth
* Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families
* Extensive benefit offerings including health, dental, and vision coverage, company paid short\-term disability, and optional pet insurance
* 401k match after one year of service
* Access to our primary care (depending on location)
* Educational Alliance with Purdue University Global and reduced tuition rates for team members and their families
* Employer rewards and access to discounts offered on services and products such as hotels, travel, entertainment, restaurants, and more


*There's a job and then there's purposeful, transformative work. Our aim is to create a workplace where you can learn, grow, and continuously refine your skills. Applicants rarely meet every single job requirement, and we appreciate that many skills and backgrounds can make people successful in this role. We are committed to creating a strong sense of belonging for all team members, and our process is designed to prevent discrimination against applicants regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, disability status, or any other aspect which makes you unique. If you're looking for a great next step, and want to feel good about what you do, we'd love to hear from you.*



It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

**Insurance Broker Administrative Assistant / Base Shop Coordinator**

**Position:** Insurance Broker Administrative Assistant / Base Shop Coordinator  
**Industry:** Life Insurance \& Annuities / Financial Services  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time or Part\-Time  
**Work Setting:** In\-Person  
**Compensation:** Base compensation based on experience, with eligibility for performance\-based bonuses and opportunities for increased compensation as the organization grows.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail\-oriented **Insurance Broker Administrative Assistant / Base Shop Coordinator** to support the administrative and operational needs of a growing life insurance and annuity brokerage.

This position plays an important role in supporting our agents throughout the licensing and contracting process, monitoring new business, coordinating with insurance carriers, and maintaining accurate operational records.

The ideal candidate is an effective communicator who is comfortable managing multiple priorities, following up consistently, working with spreadsheets and administrative systems, and taking ownership of deadlines.

This role offers an opportunity for **professional advancement, increased responsibility, and performance\-based bonuses tied to individual contribution and overall team performance.** Compensation growth and bonuses are not guaranteed and may be based on applicable performance criteria.

**Position \& Scope of Work**

The Base Shop Coordinator will apply their professional skills and services toward supporting the administrative and operational needs of the Company.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

**Agent Licensing \& Onboarding**

* Coordinate the licensing process for new and existing agents and work toward ensuring licensing requirements are completed in accordance with applicable state and company requirements, with a target completion timeframe of approximately **7–14 days**, when feasible.
* Coordinate and track agent licensing progress, license renewals, and outstanding licensing requirements.
* Maintain frequent communication with agents regarding licensing study materials, exam scheduling, exam dates, exam outcomes, and next steps.
* Assist agents with rescheduling insurance exams and fingerprint appointments when necessary.
* Follow up consistently with agents, carriers, licensing departments, and other relevant parties to facilitate timely completion of licensing requirements.

**Carrier Contracting \& Appointments**

* Monitor agent contracting and carrier appointment processes.
* Track the status of carrier appointments and producer codes.
* Follow up with carriers and appropriate departments with the goal of helping agents receive producer codes promptly, including a target of approximately **7 days after the required license information has been uploaded into the company’s designated system.**
* Identify contracting or appointment delays and communicate outstanding issues to the appropriate agents and leadership.

**New Business \& Policy Placement**

* Monitor new business submissions originating from the base shop.
* Conduct appropriate follow\-up with agents, clients, insurance carriers, and relevant departments regarding outstanding new\-business requirements.
* Track pending applications through the underwriting and placement process.
* Help identify outstanding requirements that could delay policy issuance or placement.
* Maintain consistent communication with agents regarding pending cases and required actions.
* Assist in supporting timely policy placement and strong policy persistency.

**Tracking, Reporting \& Administration**

* Maintain accurate records of licensing, contracting, policy placement, and persistency using company systems, shared documents, and spreadsheets.
* Keep tracking documents current and organized.
* Provide regular updates to leadership regarding licensing progress, pending business, outstanding requirements, carrier issues, and other operational matters.
* Escalate time\-sensitive issues or significant delays to leadership when appropriate.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling agent, client, licensing, and business information.
* Attend designated office meetings, trainings, and other important company events as required for the position.
* Provide additional administrative and operational support as reasonably required.

**Qualifications**

The ideal candidate will possess:

* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple agents, cases, deadlines, and follow\-up items simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-through and willingness to proactively contact agents, carriers, and departments until outstanding items are resolved.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, shared documents, email, and web\-based business systems.
* Ability to learn insurance carrier portals and licensing/contracting procedures.
* Professional communication skills when interacting with agents, clients, carriers, and company leadership.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive business information appropriately.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.

**Previous experience in insurance, financial services, insurance licensing, carrier contracting, new\-business processing, case management, or administrative operations is preferred but not required for candidates with strong organizational and communication skills.**

**Growth \& Compensation Opportunity**

This position is designed for someone who wants more than a traditional administrative role.

As the organization grows, there may be opportunities to take on greater responsibility in areas such as **operations, agent onboarding, licensing management, new\-business coordination, case management, team administration, and leadership support.**

In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may have opportunities to earn **performance\-based bonuses tied to defined individual and/or team performance objectives.**

Potential compensation growth may reflect factors such as:

* Timeliness of licensing and contracting follow\-up.

**BÜNDA Sacramento \& BÜNDA Roseville**  
**Position:** Group Fitness Trainer / Instructor

**About BÜNDA**

BÜNDA is a science\-backed group fitness concept that combines **strength training and steady\-state cardiovascular training** in a structured, high\-energy environment.

Our program places a strong emphasis on frequently training the lower body, progressive strength training, and StairMaster\-based cardio to create an effective, low\-impact workout appropriate for a wide range of fitness levels.

Every BÜNDA class is led by a qualified personal trainer, allowing us to provide members with the energy and community of group fitness while maintaining the education, attention, and coaching expected from personal training.

**The Role**

We are looking for **energetic, knowledgeable, and highly coachable fitness professionals** who want to develop their skills as trainers and group fitness coaches.

As a BÜNDA Trainer, you’ll lead members through our structured, pre\-programmed workouts while creating an engaging, motivating, and personalized experience for every person in the room.

This role is about much more than bringing energy to a class. Our trainers are expected to **coach, educate, correct, motivate, and connect with members.**

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and motivate members through BÜNDA's pre\-programmed strength and cardio workouts.
* Coach proper exercise technique, positioning, tempo, and execution.
* Provide appropriate progressions and regressions based on individual fitness levels.
* Educate members on the purpose and intent behind exercises and training methods.
* Coach members through progressive overload and appropriate weight selection.
* Provide clear, confident, and engaging instruction throughout class.
* Create an energetic and welcoming environment for beginners and experienced members alike.

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and results\-driven Lead Booker to join our sales team, where you will play a pivotal role in managing the booking process for high\-value technology solutions. As the Lead Booker, you will oversee outbound calling campaigns, engage with prospective clients through consultative communication, and leverage advanced sales technology to close deals efficiently. Your expertise in B2B sales, CRM systems, and customer service will drive revenue growth and enhance client satisfaction. This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead by example in a fast\-paced environment that values innovation, teamwork, and professional development.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead outbound calling initiatives to identify and qualify potential clients for technology sales opportunities
* Engage in consultative selling by understanding client needs and presenting tailored solutions that meet their business objectives
* Utilize CRM software such as Salesforce to track interactions, manage pipelines, and update customer records accurately
* Negotiate terms and close deals effectively while maintaining a high level of customer service throughout the sales process
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless onboarding and ongoing support for clients post\-sale
* Adopt and promote the use of sales automation technologies to increase efficiency and outreach effectiveness
* Maintain strong communication skills during phone conversations, ensuring clear client communication and relationship building

Lead Booker

**Starting Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–3:00 PM, with up to 5 shifts available per week  
**Starting Pay:** $12\.00/hour \+ Performance Bonus Opportunities  
**Department:** Operations / Client Experience  
**Reports To:** Management

Position Overview

Happy Pup Spa is looking for a motivated, outgoing, and results\-driven **Lead Booker** to help keep our groomers busy and our appointment books full.

The primary focus of this position is **proactive appointment booking**. Rather than waiting for the phone to ring, the Lead Booker will identify openings in our groomers' schedules and actively reach out to new, existing, and lapsed clients to generate appointments.

The Lead Booker will also help manage client communications, vaccination records, reception coverage, and ongoing administrative needs.

This is a position with **room to grow**. The starting shift is 9:00 AM–3:00 PM, with up to five shifts available each week. As the Lead Booker demonstrates consistent booking success, reliability, and the ability to positively impact the business, **additional hours and expanded opportunities may become available.**

Primary ResponsibilitiesOutbound Booking \& Schedule Management

Booking is the primary focus of this position.

* Lead daily outbound calling and texting campaigns to generate appointments.
* Regularly review upcoming schedules to identify openings and booking opportunities.
* Proactively contact clients who are due or overdue for their next grooming appointment.
* Re\-engage clients who have fallen out of their regular grooming schedule.
* Follow up with leads and clients who have not yet booked.
* Promote approved specials, VIP scheduling, and other booking incentives.
* Quickly work to fill openings created by cancellations or schedule changes.
* Prioritize specific groomers, locations, or days based on current business needs.
* Track outbound activity, appointments generated, and booking results.
* Work toward daily, weekly, and monthly booking goals established by management.

Client Communication

* Monitor **MoeGo messages throughout the day** and ensure clients receive timely responses.
* Monitor company email and respond to or appropriately route client inquiries.
* Follow up on missed calls, appointment requests, and other booking opportunities.
* Communicate professionally and enthusiastically with clients by phone, text, email, and in person.
* Escalate client concerns or situations requiring management assistance when appropriate.

Vaccination Upkeep

* Regularly review upcoming appointments for missing or expired rabies vaccination records.
* Proactively contact clients to request updated documentation before their appointments.
* Update vaccination information in MoeGo as documentation is received.
* Help ensure vaccination requirements are addressed before pets arrive at the spa.

Administrative \& Spa Support

When booking and client communication responsibilities are current, the Lead Booker will assist with additional operational needs, including:

* Completing administrative projects assigned by management.
* Maintaining accurate and organized client information.
* Assisting with appointment confirmations and schedule adjustments.
* Covering reception as needed.
* Checking clients in and out when providing reception coverage.
* Supporting the cleanliness and organization of reception, office, and client\-facing areas.
* Assisting with light cleaning and other spa\-support responsibilities.
* Completing additional administrative or operational projects as assigned.

Compensation \& Performance Bonuses

**Starting Pay: $12\.00 per hour**

The Lead Booker will also have the opportunity to earn **performance\-based bonuses tied directly to booking success.**

Performance may be measured using factors such as:

* Appointments generated through outbound efforts.
* Completed revenue resulting from those appointments.
* Achievement of monthly booking goals.
* Success filling priority days and groomer schedules.
* Overall effectiveness of outbound booking campaigns.

Our goal is to reward results: **the more successful you are at generating appointments and helping keep our groomers booked, the greater your opportunity to earn.**

Specific booking targets and bonus tiers will be communicated by management and may be adjusted based on business needs.

Schedule \& Growth Opportunity

The **starting shift is 9:00 AM–3:00 PM**, Monday through Friday, with up to five shifts available each week.

This position is designed to grow with success.

As the Lead Booker demonstrates strong booking performance, reliability, initiative, and the ability to take ownership of their responsibilities, **additional hours may become available.**

There may also be opportunities to take on expanded administrative and operational responsibilities as the position develops.

We want someone who is interested in growing with the role. **Consistent results create greater opportunities for hours, responsibility, and earning potential.**

What Success Looks Like

The Lead Booker should be **proactive rather than reactive**.

You shouldn't be waiting for clients to contact us. You should regularly be asking:

**Where are the openings? Who needs to be booked? Who can I contact to fill them?**

A successful Lead Booker:

* Consistently generates appointments through outbound efforts.
* Helps maintain full groomer schedules.
* Responds quickly when cancellations create new openings.
* Meets or exceeds established outbound and booking goals.
* Keeps MoeGo messages and emails organized and answered.
* Maintains accurate vaccination records.
* Provides warm, professional client communication.
* Uses downtime productively.
* Takes ownership of their responsibilities without requiring constant direction.
* Looks for opportunities to help the spa grow.

Ideal Candidate

We're looking for someone who is:

* Confident, friendly, and personable on the phone.
* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.
* Motivated by goals, results, and performance bonuses.
* Sales\-minded while maintaining a warm, client\-focused approach.
* Organized and capable of managing multiple priorities.
* A strong verbal and written communicator.
* Comfortable learning scheduling and client\-management software.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Reliable, punctual, and consistent.
* Willing to assist wherever needed, including reception and light cleaning.
* Excited about the opportunity to **earn more responsibility and hours through strong performance.**

The Opportunity

This is more than a traditional reception position. The Lead Booker directly contributes to the success of our groomers and the growth of Happy Pup Spa.

We provide the tools, client base, and opportunities—the Lead Booker's job is to turn those opportunities into appointments.

**Starting Schedule:** 9:00 AM–3:00 PM  
**Up to:** 5 shifts per week  
**Starting Pay:** $12\.00/hour  
**Additional Earning Opportunity:** Performance\-based booking bonuses  
**Growth Opportunity:** Additional hours and responsibilities based on performance

Pay: From $12\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Assistant General Manager
jobs.description:
**Assistant General Manager**

**Company:** WOW Moving \& Storage  
**Location:** New Jersey  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reports To:** General Manager

**About WOW Moving \& Storage**

WOW Moving \& Storage is an established, full\-service moving and storage company serving residential and commercial customers throughout New Jersey, New York, and beyond. With a history dating back to 1984, WOW has built its reputation around personalized service, attention to detail, professionalism, and dependable execution.

As an agent for Allied, WOW combines the resources and capabilities of a national carrier with the responsiveness and personal service of a locally operated moving company. The company provides local and long\-distance moving, residential and commercial relocation, packing, storage, and related services.

WOW is seeking an experienced **Assistant General Manager** to help lead the day\-to\-day operational side of the business. This is an operations\-focused leadership position and does **not** include responsibility for sales or business development.

**Position Overview**

The Assistant General Manager will work closely with the General Manager to oversee the daily operations of WOW Moving \& Storage, with particular responsibility for drivers, moving crews, dispatch, scheduling, operational compliance, safety, and the successful execution of customer moves.

This person will help ensure that the right people, equipment, vehicles, and resources are in the right place at the right time and that each move is completed safely, efficiently, professionally, and in accordance with company standards and applicable regulations.

The Assistant General Manager will be highly visible within the operation and will develop strong working relationships with drivers, movers, dispatch personnel, warehouse and operations staff, and company leadership. The successful candidate will be comfortable solving problems in real time, holding people accountable, communicating clearly, and making sound operational decisions in a fast\-moving environment.

This position is ideal for an experienced moving, transportation, logistics, or operations professional who understands that excellent customer service begins with excellent execution behind the scenes.

Key ResponsibilitiesOperations Management

· Assist the General Manager with the overall day\-to\-day operation of the company.

· Help oversee daily moving operations to ensure jobs are properly staffed, scheduled, dispatched, equipped, and completed.

· Coordinate drivers, moving crews, vehicles, equipment, and operational resources based on daily and weekly requirements.

· Review upcoming jobs and proactively identify staffing, scheduling, equipment, routing, or logistical concerns.

· Help maintain an organized and efficient operation during both normal business periods and peak moving seasons.

· Monitor the progress of jobs throughout the day and respond quickly when schedules, customer circumstances, staffing, traffic, equipment, or other conditions change.

· Troubleshoot operational problems and make timely decisions to keep jobs moving.

· Work closely with the General Manager to continually improve operational efficiency, consistency, accountability, and service quality.

Dispatch \& Scheduling

· Provide leadership and oversight for the dispatch function.

· Coordinate daily driver and crew assignments based on job requirements, availability, experience, equipment needs, and applicable regulations.

· Ensure drivers and crews receive accurate information regarding schedules, locations, job requirements, equipment, paperwork, and customer expectations.

· Maintain regular communication with drivers and crews throughout the workday.

· Monitor job status, delays, schedule changes, and other issues that could affect operations.

· Adjust schedules and resources when unexpected circumstances arise.

· Help ensure efficient utilization of drivers, crews, trucks, equipment, and company resources.

Driver \& Crew Management

· Build strong, professional relationships with drivers, movers, crew leaders, dispatch personnel, and other operational employees.

· Help supervise, coach, develop, and hold operational employees accountable for performance.

· Reinforce expectations regarding attendance, punctuality, appearance, professionalism, safety, customer service, equipment care, and company procedures.

· Address operational and personnel issues promptly and professionally.

· Participate in onboarding and operational training for new drivers and moving personnel.

· Help evaluate driver and crew performance and identify opportunities for additional training or development.

· Promote a culture of teamwork, accountability, professionalism, safety, and respect.

· Help ensure crews consistently represent WOW Moving \& Storage professionally in customers’ homes, businesses, and communities.

Safety, Regulatory \& DOT Compliance

· Help oversee compliance with applicable federal, state, DOT, FMCSA, transportation, safety, and moving\-industry regulations.

· Maintain a working knowledge of regulations affecting interstate and intrastate moving operations.

· Help ensure drivers maintain required licenses, qualifications, documentation, medical certifications, and other applicable credentials.

· Monitor compliance with Hours of Service and other driver requirements where applicable.

· Help oversee driver qualification files, vehicle documentation, inspection requirements, maintenance records, accident documentation, and other required operational records.

· Reinforce company safety policies and safe driving expectations.

· Help ensure required vehicle inspections, maintenance, and repairs are completed and documented appropriately.

· Participate in the review and follow\-up of accidents, incidents, safety concerns, claims\-related operational issues, or regulatory matters.

· Identify potential compliance concerns before they become larger operational or regulatory problems.

· Maintain a strong safety\-first mindset throughout the operation.

Fleet \& Equipment Coordination

· Help oversee the daily readiness and availability of company trucks, vans, trailers, moving equipment, and operational supplies.

· Coordinate vehicle maintenance and repairs to minimize downtime and operational disruption.

· Ensure vehicles and equipment are properly maintained, inspected, clean, safe, and ready for service.

· Work with drivers and crew leaders to identify vehicle or equipment concerns quickly.

· Maintain visibility into fleet availability when planning daily and upcoming schedules.

· Help protect company assets by reinforcing proper use and care of vehicles, equipment, tools, and facilities.

MoversSuite \& Operational Systems

· Utilize **MoversSuite** as a central operational tool for scheduling, dispatch, job management, documentation, communication, and related operational functions.

· Maintain accurate and timely information within the company’s operating systems.

· Help ensure operational personnel consistently follow established processes for entering, updating, and maintaining information.

· Use operational data to identify scheduling issues, resource needs, recurring problems, and opportunities for greater efficiency.

· Support the General Manager in improving processes and workflows within MoversSuite and other company systems.

Leadership Expectations

The Assistant General Manager will be expected to lead from within the operation rather than manage exclusively from an office.

The right person will know what is happening with the day’s jobs, understand where drivers and crews are, recognize when a problem is developing, and be willing to step in to help solve it.

This individual should be approachable and relational while also being comfortable establishing expectations and holding people accountable. WOW needs someone who can earn the respect of experienced drivers and moving professionals while maintaining the standards required to operate a safe, professional, and efficient moving company.

The Assistant General Manager should also be capable of assuming greater operational responsibility when the General Manager is unavailable.

Qualifications \& ExperienceRequired

· Previous operations leadership, transportation management, dispatch, logistics, moving industry, or comparable experience.

· Experience working directly with drivers, field personnel, crews, or transportation employees.

· Strong understanding of dispatching, scheduling, routing, staffing, and day\-to\-day operational coordination.

· Working knowledge of DOT, FMCSA, transportation safety, driver compliance, and other applicable regulations.

· Demonstrated ability to manage multiple jobs, employees, vehicles, schedules, and priorities simultaneously.

· Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to make sound decisions under pressure.

· Ability to communicate effectively with drivers, moving crews, office personnel, management, customers, and outside partners.

· Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

· Comfortable using technology and operational management software.

· Ability to establish expectations, address performance concerns, and hold employees accountable professionally.

· Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record.

· Ability to work the schedule necessary to support a moving and transportation operation, including early mornings and occasional extended hours during peak periods.

Preferred

· Previous management or supervisory experience within the moving and storage industry.

· Experience with **MoversSuite** moving and storage management software.

· Experience working within an Allied or other major van line environment.

· Experience managing both local and interstate moving operations.

· Strong understanding of moving\-industry documentation, driver requirements, safety practices, and regulatory compliance.

· Fleet management or commercial vehicle operations experience.

· Experience supervising dispatch personnel, drivers, movers, or crew leaders.

· **Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills.**

Who Will Thrive in This Role

The successful Assistant General Manager will be someone who enjoys operations and takes satisfaction in making a complicated day run smoothly.

You are organized without becoming rigid. You understand that plans change constantly in transportation and moving operations, and you know how to adjust without allowing the operation to become chaotic.

You communicate well with drivers and field employees and understand that earning their respect requires consistency, knowledge, fairness, and follow\-through.

You pay attention to details because you understand that a missed inspection, incomplete document, scheduling mistake, unavailable truck, or communication breakdown can quickly become a much larger problem.

You are comfortable holding people accountable, but you also know how to coach and develop employees rather than simply tell them what they did wrong.

You understand transportation regulations and take compliance seriously. Safety and regulatory requirements are part of running a professional operation, not administrative tasks to deal with later.

Most importantly, you take ownership. When something goes wrong, you focus on solving the problem, communicating clearly, and making sure the operation continues moving forward.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means WOW’s daily operation is organized, predictable, compliant, and well led.

Drivers and crews know where they need to be and what is expected of them. Trucks and equipment are ready. Jobs are properly staffed. Dispatch communicates effectively. Operational records are accurate. Compliance requirements are addressed. Problems are identified early and resolved quickly.

The General Manager has a trusted operational leader who can take ownership of the details, manage the day\-to\-day activity of the business, and help ensure that WOW Moving \& Storage consistently delivers the professional experience its customers expect.

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year

Education:

* High school or equivalent (Preferred)

Experience:

* Operations Leadership: 5 years (Preferred)
* Transportation management: 5 years (Preferred)
* Dispatching: 3 years (Preferred)
* Moving Industry: 3 years (Preferred)
* MoversSuite: 3 years (Preferred)

Language:

* Bilingual English/Spanish (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* Driver’s license (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Midland Park, NJ 07432 (Preferred)

Ability to Relocate:

* Midland Park, NJ 07432: Relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

**About Iredell EDC**  
The Iredell County Economic Development Corporation (Iredell EDC) promotes economic growth, job creation, and community prosperity throughout Iredell County. We partner with local government, industry leaders, and educational institutions to support business development and enhance the economic vitality of the region. We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive **Office Manager/Executive Assistant** to join our team.

We are looking for an professional who brings energy, precision, and a passion for organizational excellence to our mission\-driven team. This is a unique opportunity to play a central role in ensuring that Iredell EDC runs smoothly and effectively each day. The person in this role will help connect people, systems, and processes—supporting operations, financial management, board and investor engagement, and key events that shape our work across the county and region.

We are seeking someone who is exceptionally organized, detail\-oriented, and skilled at managing multiple priorities at once. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating QuickBooks and Microsoft Office, learning new systems like CRMs, and ensuring timely and accurate communication and records for our board(s) and investor relations efforts. They maintain accuracy even under tight deadlines, communicate with polished professionalism, and naturally create structure in environments with many moving pieces. Someone who anticipates needs, is a critical thinker, solves problems before they escalate, and maintains confidentiality, will thrive in this role.

Just as important, we are looking for a team member with strong interpersonal skills and a supportive, service\-minded approach. This role requires a person who builds trust, collaborates with ease, and interacts with investors, board members, and community partners with confidence and warmth. Adaptability, resilience, and a positive attitude are key, as is the ability to take initiative and work independently. If someone is motivated by making an organization stronger behind the scenes and enjoys creating order, consistency, and quality in everything they touch, they will make a significant and meaningful impact at Iredell EDC.

**Human Resources**

Digital Marketing Promotion Team (DMPT) is a digital promotion community that helps businesses, brands, creators, organizations, and campaigns increase online awareness through authentic social media promotion and audience engagement.

We work with real people to help digital content reach wider audiences across social media platforms.

We are currently expanding our remote promotion team in Nigeria and are looking for individuals who are active on social media and interested in gaining practical experience in digital marketing and social media promotion while earning compensation for eligible completed assignments.

What You'll Do

As a Social Media Promotion Associate, you may participate in digital marketing assignments involving:

* Sharing approved promotional content through your social media platforms or personal network
* Helping increase awareness and reach for approved digital campaigns
* Engaging with approved social media content where appropriate
* Supporting content distribution across social media platforms
* Participating in online community and audience\-engagement activities
* Following campaign instructions and completing assigned promotional activities
* Providing confirmation when an assigned activity has been completed

Specific activities will depend on each campaign.

Compensation

This is a **task\-based paid opportunity and not a fixed monthly salary position**.

Eligible assignments have a predetermined payment amount. Participants are informed of the assignment requirements and applicable compensation before completing the assignment.

Payments are made in Nigerian Naira (₦) for successfully completed and approved eligible assignments.

The number and type of assignments available may vary, and no specific amount of monthly income or number of assignments is guaranteed.

Flexible Remote Participation

This opportunity is remote and designed to provide flexibility.

Assignments may become available at different times depending on current campaigns. Participants are expected to carefully review the requirements of an assignment before participating and complete accepted assignments according to the provided instructions.

Who We're Looking For

Applicants should:

* Be based in Nigeria
* Have reliable internet access
* Have access to a smartphone or other internet\-enabled device
* Be familiar with common social media platforms
* Be able to follow written instructions accurately
* Communicate professionally online
* Be dependable when accepting an assignment
* Have an interest in social media, digital marketing, content promotion, or online community engagement

Previous professional digital marketing experience is **not required**.

Marketing \& Engagement Standards

**Help people discover freedom, confidence, and joy through cycling.**

* You’ll help children gain confidence that carries into every part of their lives.

* You’ll empower families, commuters, and recreational riders to feel safe and capable on two wheels.

jobs.title: Recruiting Manager
jobs.description:
**Base Salary: $70,000\-$75,000 \| Total Compensation Opportunity: $100,000\-$120,000**


Build the Team. Improve the Process. Grow With Us.
Southern National Roofing is looking for an experienced, hands\-on Recruiting Manager to lead and improve our recruiting efforts as we continue to grow. This is not a desk\-only recruiting management position.


We're looking for a builder and player\-coach \- someone who can lead and develop recruiters, personally recruit when needed, learn our business from the inside, identify opportunities for improvement, and help us build the hiring infrastructure needed for our next stage of growth.


Southern National is currently experiencing approximately 40% year\-over\-year growth, and this position is expected to grow as the company does.


What You'll Do
You'll lead a small recruiting team responsible for hiring Sales Consultants, Sales Managers, Canvassers, Canvassing Managers, Call Center Team Members, Department Managers, and selected Senior Management positions.

* Lead, coach, and develop the recruiting team.
* Personally source, recruit, screen, and interview candidates when needed.
* Improve sourcing strategies, job postings, screening, interviewing, and candidate selection.
* Build recruiting metrics, reporting, goals, and accountability.
* Improve quality of hire and employee retention.
* Source and recommend Sales Managers, Canvassing Managers, and selected senior leaders.
* Develop future Recruiting Team Leads and Managers.
* Partner closely with department and senior leadership before implementing material changes.


Learn the Business by Doing
We believe you recruit better when you truly understand the positions you're trying to fill. Especially during your first several months, you'll spend time throughout the business learning how our teams operate. That may include sitting alongside employees, spending time with managers, participating in ride\-alongs with sales or canvassing teams, and, when appropriate, sitting in the seat or performing portions of a job to understand the process firsthand.


This isn't just an onboarding exercise. Southern National is a hands\-on company. If someone is out, workload surges, or the business needs temporary support, our managers are expected to be willing to step in and help.


Immediate Priority \- Sales Recruiting
One of your first priorities will be improving Sales Consultant recruiting. We need to increase our Sales Consultant team by approximately 10\-15 people while improving retention through better quality of hire.


We do not expect you to spend 90 days studying the problem before making an impact. You'll be expected to learn and act at the same time \- personally participating in recruiting, identifying opportunities for improvement, and beginning to generate results.

**Understand the business. Identify the opportunity. Consult with senior leadership. Then act quickly.**


We move quickly. Consultation is not intended to create layers of approval; in most cases it is simply a conversation with the appropriate leader before a material change is implemented.


Help Build Our Hiring Infrastructure
Working with company leadership and with support from HR and legal resources, you'll help develop and improve hiring packets, interview guides, candidate scorecards, job descriptions, onboarding processes, recruiting and hiring SOPs, hiring manager guidelines, and the employee handbook. Prior HR experience is helpful but not required.

 **Requirements**  

  

Who We're Looking For* Someone who still enjoys recruiting and interviewing candidates.
* Experience leading, coaching, or developing recruiters.
* Comfort being both a manager and an individual contributor.
* Experience with high\-volume recruiting and management\-level searches.
* Experience recruiting commissioned sales professionals strongly preferred.
* Good judgment: knows when to act independently and when a quick leadership conversation is appropriate.
* A builder who wants to improve processes, develop people, and grow with the company.
* Home services, roofing, remodeling, solar, HVAC, pest control, or similar experience is a plus.
* HR generalist or HR operations experience is a plus.
* Must be willing to work on\-site in Charlotte, NC.

 **Benefits**  

  

Compensation \& Benefits* Starting base salary: $70,000\-$75,000\.
* $5,000 annual base salary increase after 90 days based on successful completion of initial objectives.
* Performance\-based bonus opportunity.
* Total compensation opportunity: approximately $100,000\-$120,000\.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Paid company holidays.
* One week of PTO during Year One; two weeks beginning in Year Two.
* Career and leadership growth opportunities.


Your Opportunity Isn't Limited to Recruiting
With approximately 40% year\-over\-year growth, we're building teams, developing new leaders, and creating opportunities throughout the organization. As you build the recruiting team, develop future leaders, improve hiring and retention, and help build teams that contribute to company growth, the scope of your position is expected to evolve.


That growth does not have to remain within recruiting. For the right person, Recruiting Manager can be the starting point rather than the destination. Future opportunities may develop in Talent Acquisition, HR, Operations, or other areas based on performance, leadership ability, business needs, and demonstrated results.

**Learn the business. Build the team. Improve the process. Grow with Southern National Roofing.**

jobs.description:
Human Resources Manager

**Blossom Pediatrics LLC – Canoga Park, CA**  
**Full\-Time \| On\-Site**  
**Salary: Based on experience and qualifications**

Help Us Support the People Who Help Children Thrive

Blossom Pediatrics is seeking an experienced, approachable, and highly organized **Human Resources Manager** to lead our HR operations and support our growing team of pediatric professionals.

The ideal candidate is someone who understands that excellent HR management involves more than policies and paperwork—it requires building trust, maintaining accountability, supporting employees, and protecting the organization through consistent and legally compliant practices.

This position is ideal for an HR professional who is confident navigating California employment laws, enjoys improving workplace systems, and can balance compassion with clear expectations.

**About Blossom Pediatrics**

Blossom Pediatrics is a growing pediatric therapy and early intervention agency dedicated to helping children and families reach meaningful developmental milestones.

We provide early intervention, speech therapy, occupational therapy, parent education, adaptive skills training, and social skills programs throughout the greater Los Angeles area. Our multidisciplinary team includes therapists, developmental specialists, clinical leaders, and administrative professionals who share a commitment to high\-quality, family\-centered care.

Our mission is simple: **Nurturing Growth, One Milestone at a Time.**

As we continue to grow, we are looking for an HR Manager who can strengthen our employee experience, maintain consistent HR practices, and ensure our team has the structure and support needed to succeed.

**What We Are Seeking**

We are looking for a hands\-on HR Manager who can independently oversee the day\-to\-day human resources needs of a growing healthcare organization.

The right candidate will:

* Have strong working knowledge of California employment and wage\-and\-hour laws
* Apply policies fairly and consistently across all positions
* Handle confidential and sensitive matters with professionalism
* Communicate expectations clearly, respectfully, and confidently
* Provide practical guidance to managers and employees
* Maintain organized, accurate, and audit\-ready HR records
* Identify potential compliance concerns before they become larger issues
* Balance employee support with accountability and organizational needs
* Be comfortable working directly with company leadership
* Take ownership of projects and follow them through to completion

This is an active, hands\-on role—not solely a strategic or administrative position. The HR Manager will be expected to participate directly in recruiting, onboarding, employee relations, leave administration, timekeeping oversight, policy implementation, and performance management.

Key Job Duties and ResponsibilitiesEmployee Relations and Management Support

* Serve as the primary point of contact for employee questions, concerns, and workplace matters
* Provide guidance to leadership regarding employee relations, performance, attendance, conduct, and policy enforcement
* Conduct timely, objective, and well\-documented workplace investigations
* Support corrective action, performance improvement plans, and separation processes
* Coach supervisors on effective communication, documentation, and performance management
* Promote consistent and equitable application of workplace policies
* Help maintain a positive, respectful, and accountable workplace culture
* Recognize when a matter should be escalated to leadership or employment counsel

Recruiting, Hiring, and Onboarding

* Manage full\-cycle recruitment for clinical, administrative, and leadership positions
* Create and maintain accurate, engaging, and legally compliant job postings
* Review applications, conduct initial interviews, and coordinate candidate interviews
* Complete reference checks and oversee background\-clearance requirements
* Prepare offer letters and new\-hire documentation
* Coordinate onboarding and ensure all required documents are completed before employment begins
* Verify professional licenses, certifications, education, and other position requirements
* Develop effective recruiting strategies for difficult\-to\-fill healthcare positions
* Maintain organized recruiting and applicant records

Compliance and Policy Administration

* Monitor compliance with applicable federal, California, and local employment laws
* Maintain and update the employee handbook, HR policies, forms, and internal procedures
* Support compliance with wage\-and\-hour, meal and rest break, overtime, paid sick leave, PTO, reasonable accommodation, and leave requirements
* Coordinate required workplace notices, trainings, and policy acknowledgments
* Maintain confidential and properly organized personnel and medical files
* Conduct routine HR audits and correct missing or inconsistent documentation
* Monitor changes in employment requirements and communicate necessary updates to leadership
* Support workplace safety, incident reporting, workers’ compensation, and return\-to\-work processes

Leave and Benefits Administration

* Administer employee leaves of absence and maintain appropriate documentation
* Communicate leave requirements, responsibilities, and return\-to\-work expectations
* Coordinate interactive\-process and reasonable\-accommodation matters
* Assist employees with benefit enrollment questions and connect them with the appropriate benefits administrator
* Support annual open enrollment and employee benefit communications
* Maintain accurate records related to employee eligibility, enrollment, and qualifying life events

Payroll and Timekeeping Support

* Review employee timekeeping records for completeness, accuracy, and policy compliance
* Work with leadership and payroll administrators to resolve timekeeping or payroll discrepancies
* Monitor attendance, missed meal periods, overtime, and other wage\-and\-hour concerns
* Reinforce accurate documentation of hours worked, remote work, breaks, administrative time, and approved leave
* Maintain confidentiality when handling payroll and compensation information
* Assist with compensation reviews and wage\-range research as needed

Performance Management and Employee Development

* Coordinate introductory\-period and annual performance evaluations
* Monitor completion of performance reviews and related documentation
* Support supervisors in establishing measurable performance expectations
* Track corrective action and performance improvement deadlines
* Identify training needs and coordinate employee and supervisor training
* Support employee engagement, recognition, retention, and professional\-development initiatives
* Assist leadership with succession planning and organizational growth

HR Operations and Recordkeeping

* Maintain accurate employee information within HR and payroll systems
* Track licenses, certifications, training requirements, background clearances, and document expiration dates
* Prepare HR reports related to staffing, turnover, attendance, recruitment, and compliance
* Respond appropriately to requests for employment verification and personnel information
* Protect confidential employee and company information
* Recommend and implement improvements to HR workflows and systems
* Perform other HR\-related responsibilities as assigned

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Leadership, or a related field; equivalent directly related experience may be considered
* Minimum of four years of progressive human resources experience
* Previous experience independently handling employee relations and HR compliance matters
* Strong working knowledge of California employment, wage\-and\-hour, leave, and workplace requirements
* Experience with recruiting, onboarding, performance management, corrective action, and employee separations
* Experience maintaining confidential personnel records and HR documentation
* Strong written communication and professional documentation skills
* Excellent judgment and ability to handle sensitive information
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, payroll platforms, and HR information systems
* Ability to work on\-site at our Canoga Park clinic
* Ability to successfully complete all applicable pre\-employment requirements

Preferred Qualifications

* Five or more years of progressive HR experience
* Previous HR experience within healthcare, behavioral health, pediatric therapy, education, early intervention, or another regulated service environment
* Experience supporting a multidisciplinary or field\-based workforce
* Experience with ADP or a comparable payroll and HR platform
* Experience managing California leaves of absence, reasonable accommodations, workplace investigations, and workers’ compensation matters
* Professional certification such as SHRM\-CP, SHRM\-SCP, PHR, SPHR, or PHRca
* Bilingual English and Spanish communication skills
* Experience developing HR policies, procedures, training materials, and employee handbooks
* Experience supporting a growing small or midsize organization

What Success Looks Like in This Position

The successful HR Manager will:

* Develop trusted and professional relationships with employees and leadership
* Ensure HR policies are clearly communicated and consistently applied
* Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential employee records
* Respond to employee concerns promptly and appropriately
* Improve the efficiency and organization of HR processes

Schedule and Work Location

jobs.description:
Company Overview

CC Turnkey Events is a comprehensive hospitality and event management company specializing in food and beverage operations, facility management, restaurants, event venues, large\-scale catering, corporate dining, concessions, and special events.

Our organization manages multiple brands, venues, and business operations simultaneously. Technology is a major part of how we operate, including point\-of\-sale systems, online ordering, inventory platforms, CRM systems, accounting software, employee systems, websites, loyalty programs, automation tools, AI platforms, and other business applications.

The Role

We are hiring an **Executive Operations Assistant \& Technology Coordinator** to work directly with the Operating Partner/CEO.

This is a hybrid position combining **executive administrative support, technology and systems support, business operations, bookkeeping assistance, project coordination, HR administration, hospitality systems, and light marketing/design work.**

This is **not a traditional administrative assistant position**.

We are specifically looking for someone who is exceptionally comfortable with computers and technology and who enjoys figuring out how systems work.

The ideal candidate is the type of person who, when presented with unfamiliar software or a technology problem, does not immediately say, *“I don't know how to do that.”* Instead, they research it, troubleshoot it, learn the system, contact the appropriate vendor when necessary, and work toward a solution.

You will frequently assist the CEO with evaluating, implementing, improving, and connecting technology across multiple companies and locations.

You do **not** need to be a software developer or traditional IT engineer. However, you should have significantly stronger technology skills than the average administrative professional.

**Technology, Systems \& Automation**

A major responsibility of this position will be helping improve how technology is used throughout the organization.

Responsibilities may include but not limited to:

* Serve as an internal first point of contact for everyday technology and software issues.
* Troubleshoot computers, software applications, printers, user accounts, permissions, tablets, POS terminals, and other business technology.
* Learn and administer business software used throughout the organization.

* Research and help implement new restaurant and hospitality technologies.
* Help connect and improve communication between POS, accounting, CRM, inventory, online ordering, loyalty, marketing, and other business platforms.
* Research available **APIs, integrations, connectors, imports/exports, and automation opportunities** between systems.
* Assist with platforms such as Zapier, Make, or similar automation tools when appropriate.
* Identify repetitive administrative processes that can be automated.
* Assist with CRM development, configuration, data organization, and integrations.
* Help develop better inventory\-control and reporting systems across multiple locations.
* Assist with website and online\-ordering technology.
* Maintain and update websites using platforms such as **Wix**.
* Research technology vendors and compare potential solutions.

* Document technology processes and create instructions/SOPs for managers and employees.
* Assist with user setup, account access, passwords, permissions, and software onboarding.
* Help train managers and employees on newly implemented systems.

**AI \& Emerging Technology**

We actively use and explore artificial intelligence to improve business operations.

This position will help the CEO research, test, and implement practical AI applications throughout the organization.

Responsibilities may include but not limited to:

* Use tools such as **ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or other AI platforms** for appropriate business applications.
