jobs.title: School-based Crisis Interventionist
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Crisis Team Interventionist serves as a highly visible therapeutic presence throughout the program, helping students navigate behavioral crises safely while promoting resilience, emotional regulation, and positive behavioral change. Through proactive intervention, staff support, and evidence\-based crisis management, this role helps reduce disruptions, minimize restrictive interventions, and foster a safe, supportive, and therapeutic learning environment for every student.

The Crisis Team Interventionist provides immediate behavioral crisis intervention, de\-escalation, and therapeutic support for students enrolled in the Child \& Adolescent Day Treatment (CADT) Program. This position serves as a dedicated behavioral specialist who responds to escalating student behaviors, assists in maintaining a safe therapeutic environment, and supports staff in implementing proactive behavior management strategies.

The Crisis Team Interventionist utilizes trauma\-informed care, positive behavior supports, crisis intervention techniques, and therapeutic engagement to reduce behavioral escalation, minimize the use of restrictive interventions, and promote student success. This position also provides coaching to staff, assists with crisis prevention planning, and contributes to ongoing behavioral data collection and quality improvement.

**Work Schedule:**

Normal Work Hours (typically Monday\-Friday 8:00 am\-4:00 pm unless otherwise indicated, but may vary based on facility needs)

**Essential Job Responsibilities (but not limited to)**

**Crisis Response \& Intervention**

* Respond immediately to behavioral crises throughout the facility.
* Utilize verbal de\-escalation techniques to prevent escalation.
* Implement trauma\-informed crisis intervention strategies.
* Provide behavioral stabilization during emotional or behavioral crises.
* Assist students in safely regaining emotional regulation.
* Utilize evidence\-based behavior management techniques.
* Assist with crisis prevention planning.
* Participate in emergency behavioral response as needed.
* Ensure student dignity and safety during all crisis interventions.

**Behavioral Support**

* Provide direct behavioral intervention services to students.
* Implement individualized behavior support plans.
* Reinforce positive replacement behaviors.
* Model appropriate coping skills.
* Teach self\-regulation techniques.
* Support emotional regulation throughout the school day.
* Provide one\-on\-one behavioral coaching.
* Assist students with successful classroom reintegration following behavioral incidents.

**Crisis Prevention**

* Identify early warning signs of behavioral escalation.
* Develop proactive intervention strategies.
* Coach staff on recognizing behavioral triggers.
* Assist in modifying classroom environments to reduce behavioral incidents.
* Promote preventative behavioral supports.
* Support implementation of Positive Behavior Interventions and Supports (PBIS).

**Restrictive Intervention Support**

When necessary and in accordance with agency policy:

* Assist with approved restrictive interventions.
* Ensure restrictive interventions are only utilized as a last resort.
* Monitor student safety during interventions.
* Participate in post\-crisis debriefings.
* Assist with behavioral recovery following interventions.
* Ensure all interventions comply with agency policy, NCI Plus or similar approved curriculum principles, and applicable North Carolina regulations.

**Classroom Support**

* Provide behavioral support within classrooms.
* Observe classroom management practices.
* Assist teachers and behavioral staff during difficult situations.
* Help maintain structured therapeutic environments.
* Model effective behavior management techniques.
* Promote positive student engagement.

**Therapeutic Skill Development**

Teach and reinforce:

* Emotional regulation
* Coping skills
* Conflict resolution
* Problem\-solving
* Anger management
* Social skills
* Communication skills
* Decision\-making
* Stress management
* Impulse control
* Self\-advocacy
* Peer interaction
* Personal responsibility

**Therapeutic Groups**

Facilitate or co\-facilitate psychoeducational groups including:

* Anger Management
* Coping Skills
* Emotional Regulation
* Social Skills
* Conflict Resolution
* Self\-Esteem
* Bullying Prevention
* Healthy Relationships
* Substance Abuse Prevention
* Decision Making
* Stress Reduction
* Mindfulness
* Goal Setting

**Documentation**

Complete timely documentation including:

* Behavioral incident reports
* Crisis intervention notes
* Restrictive intervention documentation
* Behavioral observations
* Student progress notes (if applicable)
* Debriefing documentation
* Safety plans
* Behavior tracking forms

Ensure documentation is:

* Accurate
* Objective
* Complete
* Submitted within required timelines

**Collaboration**

Collaborate with:

* Licensed Clinicians
* Qualified Professionals
* Behavior Technicians
* Classroom Staff
* Academic Staff
* Program Leadership
* Families
* Community Providers
* School Personnel (when appropriate)

Participate in:

* Treatment Team Meetings
* CFT Meetings
* Behavioral Planning Meetings
* Clinical Staffing
* Safety Reviews

**Student Safety**

Maintain a safe therapeutic environment by:

* Supervising students during transitions.
* Monitoring high\-risk students.
* Assisting during transportation issues if needed.
* Conducting routine safety observations.
* Supporting implementation of individualized safety plans.

**Quality Improvement**

* Track behavioral trends.
* Assist with behavior data collection.
* Identify opportunities to reduce crisis incidents.
* Support implementation of corrective action plans.
* Recommend improvements to behavioral programming.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education**

Bachelor's degree preferred in one of the following preferred:

* Psychology
* Social Work
* Counseling
* Human Services
* Criminal Justice
* Sociology
* Education
* Behavioral Science
* Related field

Paraprofessionals with significant behavioral health experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum of two years working with children or adolescents with behavioral health needs preferred.
* Experience in crisis intervention.
* Experience in therapeutic behavioral services.
* Experience in school\-based or residential settings preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**

* NCI Plus or equivalent crisis prevention/intervention training
* CPR

**Knowledge \& Skills**

* Trauma\-informed care
* Positive Behavior Support
* Child and adolescent development
* Conflict resolution
* Therapeutic communication
* Emotional regulation strategies
* Team collaboration
* Professional documentation

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to lift, push, pull, or assist with up to 50 pounds as part of approved intervention procedures.

The Crisis Team Interventionist will be evaluated on:

jobs.title: Health Information Management Manager
jobs.description:
The Health Information Management Manager oversees the daily operations of the Health Information Management (HIM) Department, in coordination with the Director of HIM, while effectively coordinating, managing, and improving daily, weekly, and monthly departmental activities. This includes all areas of HIM and is responsible for the effective operations and works closely with the HIM Director and CDI Supervisor. This position requires a hands\-on management approach to ensure all aspects of Medical Record Document Management, Release of Information, Health Information systems, Master Patient Index (MPI Integrity) and Coding – are conducted efficiently, accurately, and in compliance with hospital policies and applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including privacy regulations (HIPAA), and accreditation standards. The HIM Manager requires financial judgment to maximize performance, customer satisfaction, and integrity of the legal medical record. This role requires extensive collaboration across all departments and areas impacting the revenue cycle process.

**Essential Functions**

* Under the regular supervision of the HIM Director, the Health Information Manager (HIM) effectively supervises the daily HIM departmental functions including Chart Reconciliation, Prepping, Scanning, Quality Control, Validation, Medical Record Analysis, Electronic Documentation and Systems, Master Patient Index (MPI) Integrity, Coding, and Release of information processes.
* Ensure operational workflows align with hospital policies, applicable federal, state, and local regulatory requirements, and accreditation standards.
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local laws and regulations related to health information management, including HIPAA.
* Oversee Release of Information processes in compliance with New Jersey State statutes and manages the process of release of information in accordance with the Health Information Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA). Coordinates releases for auditors, such as RAC.
* Ensures production, quality and consistency of all cases coded and interprets patient medical records to ensure an efficient and compliant coding and clinical documentation improvement process.
* Develop, implement, and maintain health information management systems that meet medical, administrative, ethical, legal, and regulatory requirements.
* Plans daily HIM operation workflow and work assignments. Reviews daily work to identify priorities for the day\-to\-day including identification and resolution of problems with achieving operation targets; adjusts work assignments of staff as needed.
* Manages the medical record completion process including but not limited to record analysis, deficiency management, and provider suspension.
* Ensures medical record reconciliation and manages the prepping, scanning, indexing and quality control process of the legal medical record. Ensures the creation of new document types as needed and correct document types are used.
* Monitors the Discharged Not Final Billed (DNFB) Report and related HIM activities to ensure timely processing of discharged medical records for coding.
* Serves as liaison between the HIM Department and other Departments responsible for the maintenance and scanning of medical records and work closely with IT and Informatics staff to ensure that health information systems are effective and meet the needs of the HIM department to support a complete, accurate, medical record.
* Manages medical record retention and destruction in accordance with New Jersey State requirement.
* Manages the completeness and timeliness of cancer reporting to the New Jersey State Cancer Registry.
* Monitor, evaluate, and report on staff productivity and quality metrics, data integrity, release of information requests, and documentation analysis.
* Prepare, generate, and present HIM reports, as needed.
* Generate HIM systems audit trails and accounting of disclosures, as requested by the HIM Director.
* Conducts monthly quality medical record audits and aggregates the data.
* Participates and leads process and performance improvement and in conjunction with the HIM Director and CDI Supervisor.
* Participates and attends meetings.
* Participate in the implementation, testing, training, and documentation of new technologies, policies, and process improvements.
* Assist in the development and revision of departmental goals, procedures, and standards; recommend improvements to optimize operational efficiency and compliance.
* Support the recruitment, training, coaching, and performance management of HIM staff; provide regular feedback and mentoring to promote professional growth and service excellence.
* Assess educational needs and process improvement for operations and coding team members, conduct team member shadowing and weekly one\-on\-one with individual team members.
* Prepare and contribute to timely staff performance evaluations.
* Act as a subject matter expert and support resource for HIM staff and physicians regarding electronic documentation and medical record documentation.
* Provide training and ongoing support for clinicians and consultants on EMR systems and dictation tools, ensuring proper documentation, editing, signing, and report completion.
* Manage HIM Operations– PTO approvals to ensure coverage is maintained – Payroll System timekeeper, tracks time and attendance, opens service desk tickets, maintains inventory of office supplies for the office, orders supplies and ensures delivery of all ordered items.
* Perform other related duties as assigned to support the HIM department and hospital\-wide initiatives.

**Other Duties:**

**Minimum Education/Certifications:**  



* Must have one of the following certifications: Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS).

**Minimum Work Experience:**

* 3\-5 years Healthcare Management experience, preferably in HIM Operations.
* Familiarity with electronic medical records (EMR), document imaging systems, medical record analysis, and release of information is strongly preferred.
* Process Improvement experience required.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with an appreciation for systems and methodology.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commitment to confidentiality and data integrity.
* Revenue Cycle driven.

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:**


Full – Time, Day shift, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM. Must be willing to work holidays, weekends and provide additional coverage as needed.

**Physical Requirements:**


Involves tasks in various categories including mobility, strength, upper extremity postural activity, sensory/perceptual skills, and adaptability to diverse work environments.

Known is what happens when a data science firm and a creative agency stop arguing and start collaborating. About the role:



Known's Media Science team uses advanced analytics, machine learning, statistics, and algorithms to plan and optimize advertising dollars. We partner with our clients to translate their business goals into meaningful metrics, and buy media across all channels to drive those target outcomes. We are looking for someone to join the team and work alongside data analysts, data scientists, media buyers, and software engineers.



As a Programmatic Senior Specialist, you'll be crucial to the success of our programmatic media campaigns. With an energetic demeanor and a passion for continuous learning, you'll oversee the execution and optimization processes, from getting strategies off the ground to resolving challenges as they arise. You'll also serve as a key partner to our programmatic managers, ensuring seamless campaign operations.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Collaborate with account leads to ensure the efficient execution of programmatic media strategies supporting client objectives.
* Keep clients informed with regular performance updates and insights, ensuring clear communication and alignment with their expectations
* Assist in the implementation and optimization of programmatic media campaigns across multiple DSPs
* Test and evaluate new programmatic features and functionalities to understand their potential benefits and adopt them where applicable
* Address and troubleshoot technical issues during campaign execution
* Partner closely with other members of the team to enhance internal tools and streamline best practices

* Proven ability to operate independently and efficiently

**Competencies**


* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to ensuring the quality and accuracy of analytics
* Eagerness to tackle challenging problems with a flexible approach
* Strategic, analytical, and proactive thinking about diverse business challenges
* Team player attitude
* Self\-driven with a proactive mindset

**SOME OF OUR PERKS**


* Unlimited paid time off

jobs.description:
**Deadline:** November 20, 2026
  

**District/Organization:** Muskegon Heights Public School Academy
  

**Position/Type:** Other, full time
  

**Salary:** $80,000 – $100,000


### **Position Details**

**We are seeking a dynamic and dedicated Special Education Director to join our Team!**

**$3,000 Signing Bonus for Administrator Certificate and MDE approval for director or supervisor of Special Education through the Office of Special Education**

**Interview this week. Decisions quickly.**

**NATURE OF THE POSITION:** This position is responsible for managing, leading and monitoring all aspects of special education to ensure the department meets the necessary local, state, and federal requirements. Also, responsible for reviewing all referrals by Academy staff and establishing procedures for the appropriate personnel and other agencies.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Must have a valid Michigan Administrator Certificate, **AND**
* MDE approval for director or supervisor of Special Education through the Office of Special Education
* Master’s degree in special education or equivalent
* Minimum of 4 years work experience in special education
* Satisfactory criminal background check.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensure compliance under all state and federal mandates including, but not limited to: IDEIA and ESSA. Develop administrative procedures and prepare state and federal reports per compliance mandates.
* Examine confidential student files to monitor for compliance with state and federal compliance.
* Serve as a contact person for parents, teachers, principals, and others from outside agencies.
* Conduct In\-service training for special education teachers and other staff members.
* Assist the principal(s) with special education staff evaluations.
* Provide and maintain child count information as required by state and federal regulations.
* Provide information for maintenance of proper class size and utilization of staff to improve special educational programs.
* Assist in the adaptation of Academy policies to include special education needs.
* Supervise the special education program’s effectiveness on a regular basis.

**OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Order testing supplies as needed by special education teachers.
* Contribute to the development of the Academy philosophy of special education.
* Assist in the recruitment, selection, and recommendation for hiring of any special education personnel.
* Secure consultants as needed to work with students with special needs.
* Collaboration and coordination with system\-wide administrators and specialists in the implementation of quality instructional programming.
* Travel if required or necessary
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**OTHER REQUIREMENTS:**

Satisfactory criminal background check.

jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


Corrections professionals who foster a humane and secure environment and ensure public safety by preparing individuals for successful reentry into our communities.

  

Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**


Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.
### **Clarification from the agency**


• THIS IS A DELEGATED EXAMINING ANNOUNCEMENT OPEN TO ALL U.S. CITIZENS. • DUTY LOCATION TO BE DETERMINED DURING SELECTION.


  
**Duties**
----------


This position involves analytical and evaluative duties related to computer networks and/or telecommunications with primary knowledge requirements of information processing methodology, information technology, computer capabilities, and processing techniques.  

  

Oversees implementation of new system hardware and software and develops operating procedures. Monitors the ongoing operation of a complex network environment with a large number of users in an installation and ensures corrective action to restore operational service is accomplished.  

  

Receives network, communications, and related operating systems from various sources such as design centers and commercial vendors and ensures that an inventory of all network hardware and software is maintained.  

  

Along with all other correctional institution employees, incumbent is charged with responsibility for maintaining security of the institution. The staff correctional responsibilities precede all others required by this position and are performed on a regular and recurring basis.


  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**


**Career Transition Programs (CTAP or ICTAP)**: These programs apply to Federal and/or DOJ employees who meet the definition of surplus or displaced from a position in the competitive service. To receive selection priority for this position, you must:



* Meet CTAP or ICTAP eligibility criteria;


* Be rated well\-qualified for the position, scoring at least half of the total possible points for the vacancy KSAs or competencies; and


* Submit the appropriate documentation to support your CTAP eligibility:
	+ A copy of the agency notice (i.e., separation notice or agency RIF letter),
	+ Most recent performance appraisal, and
	+ Most recent SF\-50 showing current/former position, grade, promotion potential, and duty location.
	+ See USAJOBS' Career Transition Programs for more information.
**EEO Statement/Policy:** The United States government does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service or other non\-merit factor. More information can be found here: U.S Department of Justice \- Equal Employment Opportunity Policy  

  

**Key Requirements:**
* U.S. Citizenship is Required.
* See Special Conditions of Employment Section.
* Selective Service Requirement


### **Qualifications**


To be considered for this position you must meet the following requirements:  

  

**Basic Requirements:**  

  

Applicants may qualify by meeting or exceeding the minimum proficiency level established for each of the required competencies listed below,  

  

**GS\-11:**  

  

The required competencies for the GS\-11 grade level are Attention to Detail, Customer Service, Interpersonal Skills, Problem Solving, Teamwork, and Technical Competence.  

  

**GS\-12:**  

  

The required competencies for the GS\-12 grade level are Attention to Detail, Customer Service, Decision Making, Information Management, Interpersonal Skills, Oral Communication, Problem Solving, Teamwork, and Technical Competence.  

  

**Competency Definitions:**

* **Attention to Detail \-** Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.
* **Customer Service \-** Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.
* **Decision Making \-** Makes sound, well\-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.
* **Information Management \-** Identifies a need for and knows where or how to gather information; organizes and maintains information or information management systems.
* **Interpersonal Skills \-** Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations.
* **Oral Communication \-** Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.
* **Problem Solving \-** Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.
* **Teamwork \-** Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals.
* **Technical Competence \-** Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on\-the\-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.


  

**AND**  

  

**Specialized Experience:**  

  

You must have one year of specialized experience at the next lower grade level (or equivalent). Specialized experience is experience that has equipped the applicant with the knowledge, skills, and abilities/competencies to perform successfully the duties of the position and is related to the work of the position to be filled but may now be obtained through other means. Such demonstratable knowledge, skills, and abilities/competences may be typically gained in the IT field or through the performance of work where the primary concern is IT.  

  

Some examples of qualifying experience:  

  

**GS\-11:**
* Experience in training end users on policies, procedures, regulations, and directives.
* Experience in performing backups and recovery of databases and file storage using provided diagnostic tools.
* Experience in network system modifications and installations.


  

**GS\-12:**
* Experience in writing policies, procedures, regulations, directives, and requirements related to physical, personnel, and information security.
* Experience in complex database and file accessing techniques, search strategies, database security procedures, backup and program recovery techniques, and testing techniques.
* Experience in developing training and providing formal or informal training to end users.


  

**OR**  

  

**GS\-11, and GS\-12:**  

  

Applicants may also be considered to have satisfied the minimum qualification requirements for a position if they can present evidence that clearly justifies a high evaluation of their competence, such as one or more of the following:
* Appropriate licensure, registration(s), certification(s); or
* A substantial record of experience, achievement, and publications that demonstrates eminence in the appropriate profession/technical field.

Applicants can qualify fully on the basis of licensure, certification, registration, or special training as an alternative to experience. **Applicants must provide copies of all such documentation when submitting an application**.  

  

If applicable, credit will be given for any acceptable experience, including paid and unpaid, as well training or non\-formal experience. To receive proper credit, you must show the actual time (such as number of hours worked per week) spent on the activities.  

  

\*\*Your eligibility for consideration will be based on your responses to the questions in the application.\*\*
### **Education**


See Qualifications Section for education requirements, **if applicable**.


**ONLY** if education is a requirement/substitution for specialized experience, applicant MUST upload legible transcripts as verification of educational requirement. Transcripts MUST be uploaded and electronically linked from USAJOBS at the time you apply and MUST include identifying information to include School Name, Student Name, Degree and Date Awarded (if applicable). All academic degrees and coursework must be completed at a college or university that has obtained accreditation or pre\-accreditation status from an accrediting body recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. For a list of schools that meet this criteria, Click Here.


*Foreign Education:* For information regarding foreign education requirements, please see Foreign Diploma and Credit Recognition at the U.S. Department of Education website: Recognition of Foreign Qualifications.


If you are selected for this position and qualified based on education (i.e. basic education requirement and/or substitution of education), you will be required to provide an OFFICIAL transcript prior to your first day on duty.


### **Additional information**


**GEOGRAPHIC LOCATION PREFERENCES****:**  

In this announcement, you will be required to select **at least** **one preferred duty location**. These preferences help us understand your interest, but they **cannot be guaranteed**. Final duty assignments are determined by the Bureau's staffing needs, availability of positions, and funding. You may receive a final offer for a location **outside your stated preferences**. By applying, you acknowledge that you may be offered employment at a duty station outside of your preferred duty locations within the Bureau of Prisons and its nationwide mission requirements. To explore available BOP institutions and offices, please visit BOP Locations**.**  

  

**AGE REQUIREMENTS:**


In accordance with 5 U.S.C. 3307, a maximum entry age of 36 has been established for initial appointment to a position in a Bureau of Prisons institution.  

  

If you are above the maximum entry age and have prior federal law enforcement coverage, you MUST submit an SF\-50 to verify prior coverage.


Qualified Preference Eligible Veterans may be exempt from meeting the maximum age. Refer to the Required Documents Section for the appropriate documentation to submit to validate veteran eligibility.


**SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT SECTION:**  

Appointment is subject to satisfactory completion of a pre\-employment and panel interview, urinalysis, physical, and background investigation.


All applicants are subject to and must satisfactorily pass all screening requirements in relation to National Crime Information Center (NCIC) and credit check.


All applicants not currently working in an institution will be required to complete a qualification inquiry regarding convictions of misdemeanor crimes of domestic violence in order to be authorized to carry a firearm.


Successful completion of the "Introduction to Correctional Techniques," three\-week training course at Glynco, Georgia is required.


Additional selections may be made if vacancies occur within the life of the certificate.


**Reasonable Accommodation (RA) Requests:** If you believe you have a disability (i.e., physical or mental), covered by the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 as amended that would interfere with completing the USA Hire Competency Based Assessments, you will be granted the opportunity to request a RA in your online application. Requests for RA for the USA Hire Competency Based Assessments and appropriate supporting documentation for RA must be received prior to starting the USA Hire Competency Based Assessments. Decisions on requests for RA are made on a case\-by\-case basis. If you meet the minimum qualifications of the position, after notification of the adjudication of your request, you will receive an email invitation to complete the USA Hire Competency Based Assessments, based on your adjudication decision. You must complete all assessments within 48 hours of receiving the URL to access the USA Hire Competency Based Assessments if you received the link after the close of the announcement. To determine if you need a RA, please review the Procedures for Requesting a Reasonable Accommodation for Online Assessments. (https://appsupport\-usastaffing.opm.gov/hc/en\-us/sections/45063131363475\-Reasonable\-Accommodation\-Information)

  


Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.


Benefits
========


A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding. Opens in a new windowLearn more about federal benefits.


**ADDITIONAL SALARY INFORMATION:**  

  

**SALARY RANGE:**  

The salary range for this announcement reflects 2026 Special Rate for Rest of U.S. GL\-11/01 $75,278 to highest GS\-12/10 San Jose\-San Francisco\-Oakland, CA, $145,468\. See OPM's Special Rates website and search the locality area for which you are applying to for more information.

Eligibility for benefits depends on the type of position you hold and whether your position is full\-time, part\-time or intermittent. Contact the hiring agency for more information on the specific benefits offered.


  
**How you will be evaluated**
-----------------------------


You will be evaluated for this job based on how well you meet the qualifications above.


You will be evaluated based on how well you meet the qualifications listed in this vacancy announcement. Your qualifications will be evaluated based on your application materials (e.g., resume, supporting documents), your responses on the application questionnaire, and your responses to all assessments required for this position.


You will be assessed on the following competencies (knowledge, skills, abilities, and other characteristics):


* Accountability
* Attention to Detail
* Customer Service
* Decision Making
* Flexibility
* Influencing/Negotiating
* Integrity/Honesty
* Interpersonal Skills
* Learning
* Reading Comprehension
* Reasoning
* Self\-Management
* Stress Tolerance
* Teamwork

  

  

The USA Hire Assessments includes a cut score based on the minimum level of required proficiency in these critical general competencies. You must meet or exceed the cut score to be considered. You will not be considered for the position if you score below the cut score or fail to complete the assessment.
Overstating your qualifications and/or experience in your application materials or application questionnaire may result in your removal from consideration. Cheating on an assessment may also result in your removal from consideration.


Your resume and supporting documentation will be used to determine whether you meet the job qualifications listed in this announcement. If you are found qualified for this job, your resume and supporting documentation will be compared to the responses you provided on the online assessment.  

  

**NOTE:** Candidates within the top\-quality category and who are eligible for veterans' preference will receive selection priority over non\-veteran preference eligibles. If you are entitled to veterans' preference, you should indicate the type of veteran's preference you are claiming on your resume.  

  

Although veterans' preference points are not assigned under the category rating procedures described under "How You Will Be Evaluated", veterans preference eligibles are listed ahead of non\-veterans within each category for which they are qualified.  

  

Preference eligibles who meet the minimum qualification requirements and who have a compensable service\-connected disability of at least 10 percent must be listed in the highest quality category (except in the case of scientific or professional positions at the GS\-9 level or higher). As noted above, an agency may not select a non\-preference eligible in lieu of a preference eligible in the same category unless there are grounds for a passover and the agency has complied with the passover procedures at 5 U.S.C. § 3318(b).

**Required Documents**
----------------------

If uploading documentation, do not identify/save your documents utilizing a special character such as %, \#, @, etc. Documentation should be identified/saved as VA Letter, DD\-214, or Transcripts.**  

  

**Veterans' Preference Documentation:**

Our client is a boutique supply chain consulting firm with a growing planning technology practice. They deliver end\-to\-end **Kinaxis Maestro** (Rapid Response) implementations for mid\-market and enterprise clients across industrial, CPG, high tech, life sciences and automotive sectors.

They are seeking a Kinaxis Maestro Solution Architect to lead solution design and configuration on client engagements. **Deep domain expertise in supply chain planning processes is critical to achieving success in this role.** This is a hands\-on architecture role — you will own the design, build and validation of the planning solution, and you will do it sitting in front of the client rather than behind a delivery manager.

Because the firm is boutique, the seat carries real breadth. You will shape how engagements are scoped, mentor consultants coming up behind you, and help set the practice's Maestro delivery standards.

**Responsibilities**

Own the solution. Lead solution architecture across full lifecycle Maestro implementations — mobilization, discovery, design, build, validation, go\-live and hyper care.

◆Lead discovery. Run discovery and design workshops with business stakeholders; translate planning process requirements into a conceptual and detailed Maestro solution design.

◆Configure hands\-on. Configure planning logic across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Enterprise Scheduling, MRP, capacity planning, ATP and attribute\-based planning.

◆Build the Maestro assets. Design and author workbooks, worksheets, task flows, alerts, automation, scripting and dashboards.

◆Integrate. Work with integration teams on data integration design, inbound and outbound interfaces, master data validation and migration from ERP and other source systems.

◆Test and validate. Support unit testing, system integration testing, planning validation and UAT through to go\-live and stabilization.

◆Mentor and advise. Provide functional and technical guidance to internal consultants and client\-side teams; act as the escalation point on planning design decisions.

◆Grow the practice. Support solutioning and scoping during the pursuit cycle and contribute to the practice's internal Maestro delivery standards and accelerators.

**Requirements**

The client has been explicit on two thresholds. Both are firm.

**◆5\+ years relevant experience — in supply chain planning, supply chain consulting or planning platform implementation.**

**◆Minimum 3 full lifecycle Kinaxis Maestro implementations — owned end to end, not partially supported. This is the client's primary screening criterion.**

Beyond those thresholds:

◆Hands\-on configuration depth across Demand Planning, Statistical Forecasting, Supply Planning, MRP, MPS, capacity planning and production scheduling.

◆Working knowledge of planning master data — material master, BOM, work centers, routings, vendor and customer master, info records, source lists, schedule agreements.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join a dynamic team at the forefront of payment, expense, and invoice innovation. At Chase Travel Consulting Services, we empower our clients with strategic solutions and ongoing support, helping them optimize their financial operations and achieve their business goals. If you are ambitious and resourceful, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


As a Senior Consultant within Chase Travel Consulting Services, you will serve as a trusted advisor to Chase Travel's premier clients, leading Concur Expense and Invoice implementations and helping organizations modernize their travel and expense programs. You will guide clients through the full implementation lifecycle, including process assessment, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, training, and post\-go\-live support. Working closely with client stakeholders and implementation teams, you will leverage your Concur expertise to deliver scalable solutions, drive user adoption, optimize business processes, and support successful organizational change.


Established as TCG Consulting, Chase Travel Consulting Services offers a suite of flexible services to bring organization's travel program to the next level. Our decades of experience combined with our patented TCO\-TMPE® approach enable organizations to achieve scalable alignment to broader company goals. Operationally, the Total Cost of Ownership for Travel, Meetings, Payment \& Expense approach enables increased spend under management, capturing all sources of program cost and yielding scalable savings and revenue opportunities.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with clients \& other departments to craft domestic or global functional design requirements and translate these into application solutions
* Translate and communicate client technical product needs to internal and external partners
* Advise clients on best practices and industry standards. Ability to “sell” clients on best practice standards during design phases
* Evaluate client business processes to determine ideal services and/or support required
* Recognize business process inefficiencies and provide recommendations for improvements
* Assist client with communication plans and training materials
* Conduct and validate process and needs assessments to perform tailored and effective product demonstrations either remotely or on\-site at a prospect's location
* Configure new software implementations or optimization changes
* Assist with responses to requests for proposals (RFP's)

* Bachelor's degree (or higher degree) required with emphasis on financial analysis, accounting, computer science, business analysis or similar field or equivalent work experience
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting Concur implementations, with additional experience in expense processing, accounts payable, consulting, or other Expense Management Systems (EMS) such as Emburse, Brex, Ramp, Navan, Coupa, Workday, or Oracle.
* Project Management experience specifically on implementation teams
* Proven track record of delivering results and practical project management techniques
* Working knowledge of various expense management systems (Concur, Emburse, Brex, Ramp, Navan, Coupa, Workday, Oracle)

jobs.title: Georgia Healthcare Strategic Partnerships Executive
jobs.description:
**This opportunity is for an established Georgia healthcare business\-development professional with existing relationships across hospitals, health systems, health plans, provider organizations, post\-acute care, Medicaid\-related organizations, or other healthcare networks.**

CareBridge Technologies, developer of the GoMedAid™ mobile digital care\-navigation platform, is seeking a Georgia\-based Strategic Partnerships Executive to introduce the platform to healthcare decision\-makers and develop licensing, white\-label, enterprise and strategic partnership opportunities.

**This is a fractional, independent, performance\-based opportunity with compensation primarily tied to successful business generated. It is not a traditional salaried position.**

**CareBridge Technologies**, the company behind **GoMedAid™**, is seeking an experienced Georgia healthcare business\-development professional with an **established network of relationships across hospitals, health systems, health plans, provider organizations, post\-acute care, case management, and related healthcare organizations.**

This is not an entry\-level sales position and is not primarily a cold\-calling role.

We are looking for an experienced healthcare relationship builder who already knows the Georgia market, can obtain meetings with decision\-makers, develop strategic partnerships, and help accelerate adoption of an emerging healthcare technology platform.

About GoMedAid™

GoMedAid is a mobile digital navigation and engagement platform designed for organizations managing **complex, multi\-step enrollment, intake, referral, and onboarding processes that require ongoing consumer participation.**

Our initial implementation focuses on **Medicaid home\-care enrollment and navigation**, where consumers and families may move through intake, eligibility information, documentation, care coordination, assessments, appointments, follow\-ups, and ongoing communication.

GoMedAid creates a consumer\-facing mobile engagement layer around these processes—helping organizations guide individuals through required steps, communicate what happens next, provide updates and reminders, and maintain engagement throughout a lengthy journey.

The larger CareBridge Technologies opportunity extends beyond Medicaid. The platform can potentially support organizations with other **high\-friction consumer enrollment, referral, intake, and onboarding journeys.**

GoMedAid is currently available on both the **Apple App Store and Google Play**.

Learn more at:

**https://carebridgetech.it/**

Who We Want to Meet

We are particularly interested in candidates who already have relationships with decision\-makers within one or more of the following Georgia markets:

* Hospitals and health systems
* Hospital care coordination and discharge planning
* Medicaid and healthcare provider organizations
* Home and community\-based care organizations
* Health plans and managed\-care organizations
* Skilled nursing, rehabilitation and post\-acute organizations
* Dialysis and chronic\-care organizations
* Case\-management organizations
* FQHCs and community health organizations
* Senior\-care and aging organizations
* Healthcare associations
* Government and community healthcare programs
* Healthcare consultants and referral networks

Existing relationships with **C\-suite executives, business\-development leadership, care\-management leadership, nursing leadership, population\-health executives, payer/provider leadership, and other healthcare decision\-makers** are highly valued.

What You'll Do

You will represent CareBridge Technologies and GoMedAid in the Georgia healthcare market and:

* Identify organizations that could adopt, license, customize, white\-label, distribute, or strategically partner around the platform.
* Leverage existing Georgia healthcare relationships to secure executive\-level introductions and meetings.
* Present the GoMedAid value proposition to prospective organizations.
* Develop strategic partnerships, pilots, licensing opportunities, and enterprise relationships.
* Attend selected healthcare meetings, conferences, and networking opportunities.
* Maintain an active pipeline of qualified opportunities.
* Work directly with CareBridge leadership to move qualified opportunities from introduction through demonstration, proposal, pilot, and agreement.

What We're Looking For

**Required:**

* Demonstrated B2B healthcare sales, partnerships, provider relations, business development, or healthcare\-market\-development experience.
* Existing professional relationships within the **Georgia healthcare market**.
* Ability to personally obtain meetings with healthcare decision\-makers.
* Proven history of developing new business rather than solely servicing existing accounts.
* Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
* Comfortable working independently in a performance\-driven environment.

Experience selling healthcare technology, SaaS, digital health, Medicaid\-related services, home health, post\-acute services, managed care, medical services, or other healthcare solutions is especially valuable.

Compensation \& Structure

This is designed as a **fractional, independent, performance\-based business\-development opportunity** with compensation tied directly to successful business generated.

The structure is intended to provide **meaningful upside for successful enterprise relationships and recurring business** without requiring a traditional full\-time schedule.

Top\-performing representatives may have opportunities for an expanded role as CareBridge Technologies grows in Georgia and nationally.

Important

We are specifically seeking candidates who **already have meaningful Georgia healthcare relationships**.

During the interview process, qualified candidates should be prepared to discuss the types of Georgia healthcare organizations and decision\-makers they could realistically approach during their **first 30–60 days**.

Pay: $25,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* 1\. Georgia relationships — REQUIRED

“Please name 3–5 Georgia healthcare organizations where you currently have professional relationships that could realistically help you secure a meeting with a decision\-maker.”

* 2\. Personal sales production — REQUIRED

“Briefly describe one healthcare account, enterprise sale, or strategic partnership that you personally originated and helped convert into a contract or revenue. What was your role?”

* 3\. Commission structure — REQUIRED, Yes/No

“Are you comfortable with a fractional independent\-contractor opportunity where compensation is primarily commission/performance\-based and there is no guaranteed base salary?”

* 4\. First 30 days —

“If selected to represent CareBridge Technologies/GoMedAid™, what types of Georgia healthcare organizations would you approach during your first 30 days?”

jobs.title: Downtown & Urban Development Manager
jobs.description:
**Hiring Range: $77,122 \- $98,331/Year D.O.Q.** **INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL** **NOT** **BE PROCESSED.**  

  

**A RESUME WILL** **NOT** **BE CONSIDERED IN DETERMINING YOUR QUALIFICATIONS FOR THIS POSITION.**  

The City of Fayetteville is currently recruiting for a Downtown \& Urban Development Manager to serve as the City's chief steward of Downtown Fayetteville and provides visionary leadership to advance the downtown as the community's economic, cultural, civic, entertainment, and tourism center. The position is responsible for fostering economic vitality, encouraging redevelopment and private investment, enhancing placemaking, strengthening public\-private partnerships, preserving the community's historic assets, and ensuring exceptional stewardship of the downtown experience and public realm.  

  

Serving as the City's lead professional for downtown revitalization, the Downtown \& Urban Development Manager plans, directs, implements, coordinates, and evaluates comprehensive strategies and initiatives that promote business recruitment and retention, redevelopment, destination development, place management, historic preservation, placemaking, and quality\-of\-life improvements. The position leads the City's day\-to\-day downtown management function by proactively identifying, prioritizing, and coordinating the resolution of issues affecting the public realm, including cleanliness, litter, graffiti, landscaping, sidewalks, streetscapes, lighting, parking, accessibility, signage, wayfinding, code compliance, beautification, and other quality\-of\-life concerns. Working collaboratively across multiple City departments—including Public Services, Engineering, Traffic Services, Police, Fire, Community Safety, Transit, Parking, Parks and Recreation, Code Enforcement, and other City departments—as well as elected officials, partner organizations, businesses, property owners, developers, and community stakeholders, the position ensures Downtown Fayetteville remains clean, safe, welcoming, economically competitive, and attractive for residents, visitors, businesses, and investors.  

  

The Downtown \& Urban Development Manager serves as the City's principal advisor on downtown revitalization strategies, redevelopment opportunities, economic development initiatives, placemaking, urban design, and downtown policy. The position exercises considerable independent judgment, initiative, and professional discretion while developing innovative solutions, building consensus among diverse stakeholders, facilitating public\-private partnerships, and coordinating complex, cross\-departmental initiatives that advance the City's strategic priorities.  

  

Success in this position is measured through demonstrable improvements in private investment, redevelopment activity, business recruitment and retention, commercial occupancy, downtown housing, public realm quality, cleanliness, safety, visitor experience, activation of public spaces, stakeholder satisfaction, and the overall vitality, competitiveness, and long\-term sustainability of Downtown Fayetteville.
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**
----------------------------------------


* Coordinate activity of downtown by facilitating engagement and activity between the City and downtown entities, ensuring that communication between stakeholders is well established.
* Serve as the City's primary coordinator for downtown revitalization, redevelopment, placemaking, and economic competitiveness.
* Develop and implement long\-range strategic initiatives that increase downtown investment, business activity, residential development, tourism, and economic vitality.
* Recruit, retain, and assist restaurants, retailers, office users, entertainment venues, hospitality businesses, and other commercial enterprises.
* Manage all administrative aspects of the downtown program, including purchasing, record\-keeping, budget development and accounting, preparing all reports required for approved grants, assisting with the preparation of reports to funding agencies and supervising part\-time employees or consultants.
* Identify redevelopment opportunities and work proactively with developers, investors, brokers, property owners, and City departments to facilitate public and private investment.
* Coordinate implementation of downtown capital improvement projects including streetscapes, public spaces, lighting, gateways, public art, pedestrian amenities, parking improvements, and beautification projects.
* Develop and/or support strategies for downtown economic development while maintaining historic preservation. Become familiar with all persons and groups directly or indirectly involved in the downtown commercial district being mindful of the roles of various downtown interest groups.
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with downtown property owners, business owners, developers, neighborhood organizations, educational institutions, Fort Bragg, regional partners, state agencies, and nonprofit organizations.
* Coordinate closely with Cool Spring Downtown District, Downtown Alliance, Chamber of Commerce, Convention and Visitors Bureau, Arts Council, Fayetteville Public Works Commission, Cumberland County, NCDOT, and other strategic partners.
* Coordinate with Police, Fire, the Office of Community Safety, homeless outreach providers, behavioral health organizations, and community partners to improve both actual and perceived public safety while supporting coordinated, compassionate responses to quality\-of\-life issues affecting downtown.
* Represent the City before elected officials, advisory boards, business organizations, neighborhood groups, developers, investors, state agencies, media representatives, and the public.
* Develop and implement marketing, branding, and destination development initiatives that strengthen Downtown Fayetteville's identity and regional competitiveness.
* Pursue, prepare, administer, and manage local, state, federal, and private grant opportunities that advance downtown revitalization objectives.
* Develop and maintain data systems to track the process and progress of the downtown program. These systems should include economic monitoring, individual building files, and information on growth, activity, job creation, and business retention.
* Constantly review the physical appearance of the downtown infrastructure (streets, lights, sidewalks, parking lots, etc.) and coordinate with existing City departments to ensure that a high level of maintenance is adhered to at all times.
  


**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------


Any combination of experience and training that would likely provide the required knowledge and abilities is qualifying. A typical way to obtain the knowledge and abilities would be:  

  

Experience:  

Five years of progressively responsible professional experience in downtown management, economic development, redevelopment, planning, public administration, commercial real estate, community development, Main Street management, business improvement district management, or closely related fields, including experience leading complex projects and working collaboratively with diverse stakeholders.  

  

Preferred:  

Experience working within a municipal government or public\-private partnership environment.  

  

Training:  

Equivalent to a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Public Administration, Urban Planning, Community Development, Business Administration, Economic Development, Architecture, Historic Preservation, Real Estate, or a closely related field; A Master's degree is preferred.  

  

**LICENSING \& CERTIFICATIONS:**  

  

Required:

  

None.  

Preferred:  

Certified Economic Developer (CEcD), American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP), Project Management Professional (PMP), National Main Street Credential or equivalent downtown management certification or International Downtown Association professional credentials.  

* **SBI/Fingerprinting Criminal History Record Check Requirement****: To comply with Sessions Law 2025\-16, applicants offered a position with the City may be subject to a criminal history record check of State and National Repositories of Criminal Histories conducted by the State Bureau of Investigation (SBI) in accordance with****G.S. 143B\-1209\.26****.** **The City may consider the results of these criminal history record checks in its hiring decisions.**

**From the time of closing, the selection process is anticipated to last** **approximately** **4 \- 6 weeks. The process will consist of a panel interview with the selected candidate being subject to a pre\-employment drug screen, background check, and driving history check.**  

An Equal Opportunity Employer
  
**Health and Dental Insurance:**  

The City of Fayetteville Employee Healthcare Benefit Plan provides comprehensive and affordable health and dental coverage while maintaining reasonable costs to employees. Coverage is available for all regular status employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week. Employees may also choose to cover eligible dependents. The premium is deducted on a pre\-tax basis, with the City paying a portion of the premium. Qualifying employees are eligible for benefits on the 1st day of the month following 30 days of service.  

  

**Employer Paid Leave**  

Vacation Leave:  

Regular employees begin accruing vacation leave the first day of employment. Accruals are based on years of service  

and the number of hours an employee is scheduled to work.  

  

Sick Leave:  

Regular employees begin accruing sick leave the first day of employment. Accruals are based on the number of hours  

scheduled to work; regular full\-time employees accrue eight (8\) hours per month. Sick leave hours accumulate without  

limits and may be used toward creditable service upon retirement from the NC Local Governmental Retirement System.  

  

Holidays:  

The City of Fayetteville observes 12 paid holidays per calendar year. When Christmas day is on a Wednesday, an  

additional holiday is provided making for 13 paid holidays.  

  

Bereavement:  

Regular employees are eligible for bereavement leave. The City will authorize 24 hours per calendar year to mourn or  

attend a funeral or memorial service of a family member.  

  

**Retirement:**  

The City of Fayetteville assists employees in securing their financial future during retirement by participating in the NC  

Local Governmental Employees’ Retirement System, administered by the State of North Carolina. Regular employees  

scheduled to work 20 hours or more per week become members in the retirement system upon employment. As a member  

of this system, employees are required to contribute 6% of their gross salary on a tax\-deferred basis.  

  

**Deferred Compensation Plans:**  

To further assist employees in saving for retirement, the City offers two supplemental retirement savings programs. These  

programs enable regular full\-time, and part\-time employees working at least 20 hours per week, an opportunity to save a  

portion of their salary on a tax\-deferred basis to supplement their retirement benefits. These programs are the NC 401(k)  

plan and NC 457 plan; both administered by Empower. The City currently contributes 4% of base salary to an eligible  

employee’s NC 401(k) account.  

  

**Cafeteria Plan / Supplemental Benefits:**  

Realizing that each employee may have different insurance needs, the City offers its employees the opportunity to supplement City\-provided benefits by selecting from the benefits listed below. These benefits are offered at employee's expense through payroll deduction:  

  

* \> Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) – Healthcare and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts (pre\-tax)
* \> Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance
* \> Optional Life \& Accidental Death \& Dismemberment

  

**Death Benefit:**  

The first year an employee contributes to the retirement system, the City provides a death benefit of $3,000 once the  

employee is benefits eligible. After one year as a contributing member of the Retirement System, a death benefit is provided  

by the NC Retirement System that is equal to the highest 12 months’ salary in a row during the 24 months before death, no  

less than $25,000 and no more than $50,000\. There is no cost to the employee for this benefit.  

  

**Pay Periods / Deduction for Benefits / Direct Deposit:**  

City employees are paid bi\-weekly (every other Friday). Benefit deductions are taken for 24 pay periods of the year. As an added convenience and safety measure, the City requires all new employees to sign up for direct deposit.  

  

**Employee Assistance Program:**  

The EAP is available at no cost to all employees and their household members. The EAP provides confidential guidance  

on legal, financial and personal issues affecting your health, relationships and job.

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact as a **Senior Human Su****bjects Protection Scientist** supporting the Office of Research and Regulatory Compliance (ORRC), Office of Human Research Oversight (OHRO) at Defense Health Agency Research \& Development (DHA R\&D).


The ORRC OHRO is responsible for ensuring that DHA conducted, contracted, sponsored, supported or managed research, and U.S. Army Medical Command investigations involving human subjects, human anatomical substances or animals are conducted in accordance with Federal, DoD, and international regulatory requirements.

The reviewer will work with the investigator to make updates/revisions to the materials to bring the protocol into compliance for OHRO approval
* Reviewers will be assigned a portfolio of protocols for initial review; this includes determinations of not research, research not involving human subjects, exempt research, non\-exempt research, and protocols utilizing cadavers/cadaveric specimens
* Provide accurate information, assistance, and documents to customers and OHRO Federal personnel when requested with appropriate professionalism in a timely manner
* This will require active management of the assigned protocol portfolio; this includes data entry activities and use of OHRO specific information management systems to track information and activities related to protocol review
* Assist the Government to develop policies, procedures, guidelines, and other materials to ensure compliance with current regulations and to update investigators, research managers and administrators, and administrative staff on human subjects protection and regulatory compliance policies and procedures as they apply to research supported by the DHA R\&D
* Assist in the development of local procedures and guidance for the OHRO and the DHA R\&D in the area of human subjects’ protection
* Support the development and implementation of effective mechanisms to communicate and interpret these regulations, policies, and guidelines
* Assist in development and implementation of internal OHRO operating procedures and review guidelines as requested
* Foster regulatory compliance through education and training of investigators, research managers, administrators, and OHRO staff, and provide assistance to program offices and investigators with interpretation of human subjects protection and cadaver use requirements
* Acquire and retain knowledge of current Federal, DoD, FDA, Army, state, host nation, and DHA regulatory requirements related to the protection of human subjects in research and cadaver use and apply knowledge of these regulations and general ethical principles during OHRO reviews of assigned projects
* Interact with colleagues, consultants, investigators, research directors, supervisors, other US Army personnel, etc., to gather or disseminate information or to provide assistance related to assigned protocols, attend meetings and conference calls as necessary, and provide education on human subjects protection regulations and OHRO requirements
* Participate in performance improvement activities and shall task contract personnel to participate in specific working groups to improve and streamline the protocol review and approvals processes, and provide input and assistance with formulating and writing OHRO standard operating procedures and work instructions

* **Required Experience:** 3\+ years of related human subjects’ protection experience
