jobs.title: IT Support Analyst (ITS)
jobs.description:
The University of Southern California’s Information Technology Services is seeking a talented IT Support Analyst with an exceptional commitment to service excellence. In this role, you will provide technology support to customers across the university’s campuses, help resolve technical issues, improve the customer experience, and contribute to effective technology and service solutions.


This is an on\-site full\-time position supporting ITS customers and teams across the university.

**Job Accountabilities**


The IT Support Analyst:

* Communicates effectively with customers, applying problem\-solving and decision\-making techniques to identify and resolve customer issues. Provides timely and flexible frontline troubleshooting support by phone and email and performs root\-cause analysis to determine when routing or escalation is needed.
* Installs and maintains current images on managed devices in client departments and develops and executes procedures for problem prevention and service improvement.
* Follows customer\-response and ticketing standards to ensure incidents and requests are documented in accordance with ITS procedures.
* Designs, writes, and edits accessible technical user documentation; documents metrics and outcomes to support planning and anticipate future business needs; and contributes to the ITS knowledge article library to minimize repeat problems.
* Provides clear and effective guidance to technical and non\-technical users and builds collaborative relationships with team members, peers, and ITS leaders.
* Supports the ITS customer service vision by working with team members and management to implement effective technology and procedural solutions. Maintains currency with technology, standards, and best practices and supports process improvement within the team and across ITS.

**Minimum Qualifications**


The candidate for the position of IT Support Analyst must meet the following qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.2 years of work experience.
* Experience with customer\-issue ticketing systems and providing technical support to customers in an operational environment.
* Experience supporting Windows, MacOS, and iOS devices, both locally and in the field.
* Ability to assess problems and prioritize actions based on importance and urgency.
* Strong collaboration, communication, and technical documentation skills, including the ability to present ideas and solutions in non\-technical, business\-friendly terms.
* Ability to develop positive working relationships and strong rapport with team members.

**Preferred Qualifications**


The ideal candidate for the position of IT Support Analyst will have one or more of the following:

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 4 years of work experience.
* Experience in higher education and/or customer service.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Office 365, password reset procedures, network troubleshooting, and/or desktop, IT, or help desk support.
* ITIL Foundations, CompTIA A\+, Microsoft, and/or Apple desktop support certification.


In addition, the successful candidate must also demonstrate, through ideas, words and actions, a strong commitment to USC’s Unifying Values of integrity, excellence, community, well\-being, open communication, and accountability.

**Salary and Benefits**


The hourly rate for this position ranges from $33\.13 to $39\.15\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors including the scope of responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, and external market considerations.


To support the well\-being of our faculty and staff, USC provides benefits\-eligible employees with a broad range of perks to help protect their and their dependents’ health, wealth, and future. These benefits are available as part of the overall compensation and total rewards package. You can learn more about USC’s comprehensive benefits here.

**Ready to Join ITS?**


If you are passionate about technology, problem\-solving, and delivering an exceptional customer experience, we invite you to apply and join USC Information Technology Services. Submit your application and resume today.

  

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS The candidate for the position of IT Support Analyst must meet the following qualifications: • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as computer science, computer information systems, etc., or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. • Two years of experience in a related field such as information technology, customer service, or higher education. • Experience providing technical customer support in an operational environment. • Ability to assess the criticality of problems and prioritize actions based on importance and urgency. • Ability to develop positive working relationships and a strong rapport with team members. • Strong collaboration, communication, and technical documentation skills. • Experience presenting ideas and solutions in non\-technical, business\-friendly terms. • Experience with customer issue ticketing systems. • Experience supporting Windows 7/10 and iOS devices, both locally and in the field.

jobs.description:
Fredrick Oak is seeking an experienced HR Customer Service Specialist to support the Department of Energy, Office of the Chief Human Capital Officer, in the DOE HR Help Center. This is a full\-time, fully percent remote position.

**Position Overview:**

The DOE HR Help Center is the first point of contact for more than 6,000 DOE employees, contractors, retirees, and external customers with human resources questions. Working as part of a small help desk team, this role provides tier\-one triage and white\-glove HR customer service by phone, email, and Workday Help tickets, guides customers through Workday and FEDHR Navigator, and escalates complex cases to the Team Lead. The position requires responsiveness, accuracy, professional written and phone communication, and sound judgment about when an inquiry needs to be escalated. You are the first impression the customer has of DOE HR.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Respond to internal and external inquiries, including phone calls, voicemails, emails, and Workday Help tickets, within one working day of receipt.
* Ask clarifying questions to understand each inquiry and determine the appropriate response or referral.
* Log all incoming calls and emails into designated workgroup systems and tools within one working day of receipt.
* Provide accurate, appropriately personalized responses to general HR questions using standard operating procedures, job aids, knowledge\-based articles (KBAs), and internal reference sites; compose customized responses where standard content does not address the question.
* Guide customers through system functionality and step\-by\-step navigation in Workday and the FEDHR Navigator.
* Assign or escalate non\-routine or complex cases to the Team Lead for routing to the appropriate Workday service team or point of contact.
* Communicate resolutions to the relevant parties and close out directly resolved tickets within one to two working days of receipt.
* Maintain current knowledge of general HR policies, leadership guidance, and key updates disseminated through official channels and weekly team training meetings.
* Propose and draft revisions to standard operating procedures, job aids, KBAs, and internal reference content.
* Monitor individual performance metrics and support service level agreement adherence.
* Participate in DOE\-wide workgroup and departmental meetings, system testing, and training.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Clear and professional written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain procedural information to a non\-specialist audience
* Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of inquiries while meeting same\-day and next\-day response standards
* Proficiency with case management or ticketing systems and standard office productivity software
* Sound judgment about when to resolve an inquiry directly and when to escalate
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in written responses and records
* Ability to work independently in a remote, fast\-paced federal help desk environment

**Education and Experience:**

* Associate or bachelor degree, or equivalent experience, preferred
* Minimum 2 years of experience in HR service delivery, HR help desk, benefits administration, or a comparable customer\-facing administrative role
* Experience supporting a federal agency with regulated HR guidelines, and the ability to absorb frequent change and identify the correct points of contact, strongly preferred
* Knowledge of Workday ticketing and case management preferred
* Understanding of federal HR terminology and Title 5 concepts preferred
* Prior experience on a federal services contract preferred

**Additional Requirements:**

* U.S. person status and eligibility to work in the United States
* Must be able to obtain and maintain the credentialing and access approvals required by the Department of Energy
* Position is 100 percent remote; a reliable, private workspace and internet connection are required

**Please note:** Performance in this position is measured against phone calls and emails answered same day to within 24 hours and all standards met 98 percent of the time. The work involves sensitive personnel information and demands professionalism, courtesy, and complete discretion in all interactions.

Anticipated start date is September 1, 2026, or as soon as credentialing permits.

**Pay and Benefits:**

$70,000 to $80,000 annually, plus eleven paid federal holidays, 15 days of paid time off per year (increasing to 20 days after six years of service), medical, dental, and vision coverage through Kaiser Permanente, company\-paid life, AD\&D, short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, and a 401(k) plan with a 100 percent vested safe harbor match.

**Equal Opportunities:**

Fredrick Oak Consulting is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

**Work Location:**

Remote (United States)

Job Types: Full\-time, Contract

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

* Vision insurance

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

**Lifting**

* 
* + Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

  

* Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1\.5'.
* Cases are usually lifted from the floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

* Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
* Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
* Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

**Pushing**

* To move trays that are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24 \- 30 and requires a force of up to 7\.5 pounds to push.
* Trays may also be pulled.

**Climbing**


Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

**Stooping/Bending**

* Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
* Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
* The duration of this position is approximately 30 \- 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
* Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

* Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).
* Must be able to make the correct monetary change.
* Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.
* Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.
* Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

**WORK CONDITIONS**

**Exposure to:**

* 
* + Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks. In\-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.
	+ Sudden changes in temperature in the work area and while outside. Fumes from food odors. Exposure to cornmeal dust.
	+ Cramped quarters including walk\-in cooler.

  

* Hot surfaces/tools from the oven up to 500 degrees or higher.
* Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

**SENSING**

* + Talking and hearing on the telephone.
	+ Near and mid\-range vision for most in\-store tasks.

  

* Depth perception.
* Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

**TEMPERAMENTS**


The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** including, but are not limited to the following:

**Standing**


Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

**Walking**


For short distances for short durations. Surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food\-process areas. The height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48\.

**Sitting**


Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

**Lifting**

* 
* + Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

  

* Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1\.5'.
* Cases are usually lifted from the floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

**Carrying**

* Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
* Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
* Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

**Pushing**

* To move trays that are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24 \- 30 and requires a force of up to 7\.5 pounds to push.
* Trays may also be pulled.

**Climbing**


Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

**Stooping/Bending**

* Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
* Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
* The duration of this position is approximately 30 \- 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
* Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

**CROUCHING/SQUATTING**


Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

**Additional Job Details**

**Reaching**

  

* + Reaching is performed continuously; up, down, and forward.
* + Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on signs, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
* + Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
* + Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

 **HAND TASKS**

  

* + Eye\-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
* + Frequently activities require the use of one or both hands.
* + Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
* + Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
* + Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
* + Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter, and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter, and pizza peel.

  

For further detailed information about job descriptions will be presented to you upon interview.

jobs.title: Waxing Specialist
jobs.description:
Wax Specialist / Esthetician / Cosmetologist

**Olive Glow Esthetics**

Olive Glow Esthetics is looking for a passionate, professional, and motivated **Licensed Esthetician or Cosmetologist** to join our growing team.

We are looking for someone who specializes in **full\-body waxing, skincare/facials, or both** and wants to continue developing their skills while building a consistent clientele.

This opportunity is ideal for a beauty professional who enjoys educating clients, creating a welcoming experience, and being part of a growing beauty and skincare brand.

Position Options

We are currently considering professionals interested in either:

**Commission\-Based Position**

* 35% service provider / 65% business commission split
* 90\-day probationary period
* Opportunity to grow within Olive Glow Esthetics
* Access to Olive Glow's brand, service environment, training, and client\-building opportunities

**Booth Rental**

* Available for experienced, independent beauty professionals
* Best suited for someone who already has clientele or is comfortable building and managing their own book of business
* Booth rental terms and expectations will be discussed during the interview process

Services May Include

Depending on your specialty and licensing:

* Brazilian waxing
* Full\-body waxing
* Facial waxing
* Customized facials
* Skincare treatments
* Client skincare education
* Pre\- and post\-wax education
* Other esthetic services offered by Olive Glow

Applicants **do not have to perform both waxing and facials**. We are open to specialists who primarily focus on waxing, skincare, or professionals who enjoy providing both.

Responsibilities

* Provide professional, high\-quality esthetic services
* Perform waxing and/or facial services according to training, licensing, and Olive Glow standards
* Maintain proper sanitation, disinfection, and infection\-control procedures
* Complete client consultations before services
* Educate clients on appropriate home care and aftercare
* Recommend appropriate services and retail products when beneficial to the client
* Maintain accurate client notes and service records
* Create a comfortable, professional, and welcoming client experience
* Maintain a clean and organized treatment area
* Arrive on time and prepared for scheduled shifts and appointments
* Assist with client retention and rebooking
* Participate in reasonable marketing and content efforts to help build clientele
* Represent the Olive Glow brand professionally in person and online
* Participate in ongoing education, training, and team development

Experience \& Qualifications

**Required:**

* Active Esthetician, Master Esthetician, or Cosmetology license applicable to services performed
* Knowledge of proper sanitation and safety procedures
* Professional and dependable
* Strong customer\-service and communication skills
* Comfortable working directly with clients
* Willingness to learn and receive feedback
* Passion for beauty, skincare, waxing, and/or client education

**Preferred, but not required:**

* Previous Brazilian or full\-body waxing experience
* Facial or skincare treatment experience
* Experience working in a spa, salon, waxing studio, or esthetics environment
* Existing clientele
* Retail or service\-sales experience
* Social media/content creation experience

**Newer professionals are encouraged to apply.** We value technique, professionalism, coachability, consistency, and willingness to grow—not just years of experience.

90\-Day Probationary Period

All new commission\-based team members will begin with a **90\-day probationary period**.

During this period, we will evaluate:

* Attendance and reliability
* Professionalism
* Client experience
* Service quality and technique
* Sanitation and cleanliness
* Ability to follow Olive Glow protocols
* Rebooking and client\-retention efforts
* Communication
* Coachability and willingness to improve
* Overall fit with the Olive Glow team and brand

Who We're Looking For

Our ideal candidate is someone who is **motivated, teachable, professional, and serious about growing in the esthetics industry**.

You do not need to come in with a completely full clientele. However, you should be willing to actively participate in building your clientele, retaining clients, creating content, educating clients, and growing alongside the company.

We want professionals who see this as more than simply completing a service—we want someone who takes pride in creating an excellent client experience and becoming stronger in their craft.

Pay: From $5\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* On\-the\-job training
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Warehouse Specialist
jobs.description:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data\-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high\-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.



At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.



Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!



We are currently looking for a Warehouse Specialist who will be integral to driving high\-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering directly with the Assistant Warehouse Manager, your focus will be on supporting Goods In and Inventory operations, including receiving deliveries, booking stock into the WMS, managing putaway and stock movements, and maintaining accurate stock levels and locations. In this role, you will combine your attention to detail with your ability to work across different warehouse functions, supporting B2B, Fulfilment, Returns and Marketplace activities as required.


### **What you will do**

* Support Goods In and Inventory operations, including receiving inbound deliveries, directing stock to the correct warehouse areas, booking products into the WMS and completing putaway.
* Maintain accurate stock levels and locations by supporting cycle counts, stock takes, system reconciliations, POs, transfers and stock movements, investigating and resolving discrepancies where required.
* Support wider warehouse operations including B2B, Fulfilment, Returns and Marketplace activities, including Trade orders, VAS, customer returns, product rework and refunds as required.
* Support day\-to\-day warehouse operations by assisting with problem orders, loading and unloading, Peak Event preparation, Quality Control projects and maintaining a clean, organised and safe working environment.
* Support the training and development of new starters, agency workers and seasonal colleagues, while demonstrating a positive and proactive approach to learning and taking on additional responsibilities.

### **What you should bring**

* Experience working in a Goods In, Inventory, retail or warehouse environment, with a good understanding of basic warehouse operations.
* Previous experience using a Warehouse Management System (WMS), with the ability to learn and use different warehouse apps and systems; some knowledge of NetSuite is desirable.
* Strong attention to detail, with a methodical, organised and accurate approach to stock and inventory activities.
* Excellent literacy, numeracy and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment.
* Reliable and punctual, with a proactive, team\-focused attitude and willingness to learn, support colleagues and take on additional responsibilities.
* Must be over 18 due to the nature of the products.

### **What we can offer you**


* We prioritize our employees' wellbeing with comprehensive healthcare coverage, dentalcare benefits, an HSA account, and life insurance. Join us and enjoy the security and peace of mind of working for a company that cares about you!
* Great staff discounts: Our employees enjoy discounts on our products and services, making it easier for them to enjoy the things they love.
* 25 days of PTO: We believe in the importance of taking time off to recharge and enjoy life outside of work. That is why we offer our employees 25 days of paid time off each year.
* Support for professional development: We want our employees to grow and thrive in their careers, which is why we offer ample support for professional development.
* Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.
### **Our interview process**


* CV review
* Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
* Hiring Manager Interview


Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
  

  

If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.
  

  

At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note\-taking. We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI\-driven note\-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role.
  

  

If we sparked your interest and you are open to embarking on your professional path with us, please visit our Lovehoney careers page to apply: Careers \\u007C Lovehoney Group
  

  

Our privacy policy is available here: Privacy Policy \\u007C Lovehoney Group



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
Starting hiring pay at: $15\.00

  

As a Cook at Raising Cane’s, you will set the pace of the Restaurant by ensuring all of the food we serve meets our high standards. Working in the Kitchen at Raising Cane’s is a fun and fast paced environment. Crank up the music and have some fun while you are working hard to prepare the highest quality chicken finger meals for our customers to enjoy. Starting out in the back of the house at Raising Cane’s can lead to many promotional opportunities for Cooks to grow their career by moving into advanced roles like Bird Specialist or Certified Trainer.


We are looking to immediately hire entry level and experienced Cooks who can thrive in an upbeat and fast\-paced food service environment. We are hiring immediately for Cooks that can work all shifts: opening shifts, closing shifts and everything in between. Whether you have previous experience as a customer service associate, retail team member, cashier, restaurant server, kitchen lead, cook, prep cook, drive\-thru cashier or any other restaurant or service\-oriented role \- we have a position for you. We offer competitive pay and benefits for all positions. Even if you don’t have previous Restaurant experience, this position is entry\-level (yes, that's no experience required) and we provide paid training for every new Restaurant Cook on the team. We will make sure you are prepared to grow your Restaurant career with us.


Within your first year of working in the Restaurant, you can earn up to an extra $1\.50 per hour in pay increases through additional training, certifications, and performance evaluations! If you want to be at Restaurant that is a FUN place to work, that values your growth and provides opportunities to impact your community, we want you on our team


Qualities of awesome Canes Restaurant Cook:

* Team player
* Excellent communicator
* Happy, Courteous and Enthusiastic
* Hard working and attentive
* Responsible and dependable
* Authentic and genuine

jobs.title: Samsung Home Theater Specialist
jobs.description:
As a Samsung Home Theater Expert, you’ll work in one of our retail stores to demonstrate and sell home theater products with emphasis on the Samsung brand. First, we’ll give you all the training you need to be an expert. Once you’re trained, you’ll explain complex technology in simple terms to help customers understand and see each product’s unique value. You’ll also work closely with other sales associates as you share your knowledge about Samsung products to ensure the team is ready to assist customers with the brand.  

  

**What you’ll do*** Maintain a high level of product knowledge about new Samsung technology
* Debrief with vendor partners and market teams about performance, promotions and sales best practices.
* Ensure the department remains organized and ready to serve customers
* Support sales strategies to achieve operating results, growth objectives and overall financial performance goals.


**Basic qualifications*** Must be at least 18 years old
* 1 year of experience in sales, customer service or related fields
* Ability to work successfully as part of a team
* Ability to work a flexible schedule inclusive of holidays, nights and weekends


**Preferred qualifications*** Prior experience serving as a specialist in premium, luxury, or complex technology solutions
* 1 year of experience working with consumer electronics

We’re committed to helping our people thrive at work and at home. Best Buy offers a range of benefits to support your overall well\-being and provide support as you need it, especially at key moments in your life.  

  

Our benefits include:* Competitive pay
* Great employee discount
* Financial savings and retirement resources
* Support for your physical and mental well\-being


Best Buy provides different types of leaves of absence (LOA) and potential pay sources to employees based on eligibility. Intermittent or reduced\-schedule leave is also available for certain medical or family care leaves. Paid time off (vacation or PTO) is offered to full\-time and part\-time employees based on work location, employment status, salary or hourly status (exempt/non\-exempt), and years of continued or bridged service.  

  

Certain roles, where market norms demand it, are eligible for various forms of incentive pay to drive performance and offer recognition for achieving financial and strategic results. For more information about our incentive pay plans, including eligibility, please refer to our Incentive Programs Summary.  

  

For more information about benefits, LOA and paid time off, please refer to our Benefits Guide.

As part of the Best Buy team, you’ll help us fulfill our purpose to enrich lives through technology. We bring that to life every day by humanizing and personalizing tech solutions for every stage of life — in our stores, online and in customers’ homes.  

  

Our culture is built on deeply supporting and valuing our amazing employees who make it all possible. We’re committed to being a great place to work, where you can unlock unique career possibilities. Above all, we aim to provide a place where you can bring your full, authentic self to work now and into the future. Tomorrow works here.™

jobs.description:
Nurse Practitioner – Mobile Primary, Chronic \& Wound Care

**Position Type:** Independent Contractor / 1099  
**Schedule:** Flexible, Mobile  
**Clinical Focus:** Primary Care, Chronic Disease Management \& Wound Care  
**Service Area:** DFW and surrounding communities

Overview

Join our growing healthcare team as a **Mobile Nurse Practitioner**, providing high\-quality primary care, chronic disease management, and wound care to patients in their homes and community\-based settings.

This is a **flexible contract position** ideal for a Nurse Practitioner seeking autonomy and the ability to build a schedule around other professional or personal commitments. The provider will manage an assigned patient caseload while collaborating with our clinical and administrative team to ensure continuity of care.

Our model emphasizes patient\-centered, accessible care for individuals who may have difficulty traveling to traditional medical offices.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform comprehensive and focused patient assessments in the home and community setting.
* Provide primary care and ongoing management of acute and chronic medical conditions.
* Develop individualized plans of care based on patient diagnoses, clinical findings, medications, laboratory results, and treatment goals.
* Order, review, and interpret laboratory testing, diagnostic imaging, and other clinically appropriate studies.
* Prescribe and manage medications within the Nurse Practitioner's scope of practice and applicable state regulations.
* Provide medication reconciliation and patient/caregiver education.
* Identify changes in patient condition and coordinate appropriate referrals or escalation of care.
* Perform comprehensive wound assessments, including wound measurements, staging/classification, documentation, and development of wound treatment plans.
* Provide wound care services within competency and scope of practice, which may include dressing management, conservative/sharp debridement, compression therapy, offloading recommendations, and coordination of advanced wound therapies.
* Monitor wound healing and modify treatment plans based on clinical progress.
* Collaborate with home health agencies, specialists, pharmacies, laboratories, caregivers, and other members of the interdisciplinary care team.
* Complete timely and accurate documentation in the electronic medical record.

**Make a Difference. Build Stronger Communities.**

At **notMYkid**, we believe every young person deserves the opportunity to thrive. For more than 25 years, we have partnered with families, schools, and communities to provide prevention education, behavioral health services, and resources that empower youth to make healthy choices. www.notmykid.org

The **Prevention Education \& Community Outreach Specialist – Mohave County** is responsible for delivering prevention education, intervention, and community outreach services that support **notMYkid**’s mission of empowering youth, strengthening families, and building healthier communities throughout Mohave County. The position serves as a field\-based representative and builds relationships with families, schools, juvenile courts, community organizations, and youth\-serving agencies and organizations. This is currently a part\-time position \- with an expectation of up to .

70% \- Prevention Education \& Presentation Delivery

20% \- Community Outreach, Program Coordination, \& Scheduling

jobs.description:
Principal Care Management Coordinator

**MD TruCare \| Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas**  
**Full\-Time**

Help Us Build a Better Way to Care for Patients

MD TruCare is a growing, physician\-led behavioral health organization serving patients across the Dallas–Fort Worth area. We provide comprehensive psychiatric care, psychotherapy, TMS, Spravato, and other advanced behavioral health services.

We are looking for an exceptional **Principal Care Management Coordinator** who believes that great healthcare requires more than scheduling appointments—it requires **ownership, follow\-through, compassion, and relentless attention to the patient journey**.

This is not a passive administrative role.

You will help identify patients who need additional care coordination, engage them between visits, communicate with clinicians and outside providers, track outstanding needs, and make sure important issues do not fall through the cracks.

If you are organized, comfortable speaking with patients, highly accountable, and energized by measurable results, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Own

The Principal Care Management Coordinator will be responsible for helping manage a defined population of patients with significant behavioral health needs.

Key responsibilities include:

* Identify and track patients who may qualify for Principal Care Management services based on established clinical and operational criteria.
* Contact patients, explain the care\-management program, and support patient engagement and enrollment.
* Serve as a consistent point of contact for enrolled patients.
* Coordinate communication between patients, psychiatric providers, therapists, primary care physicians, pharmacies, specialists, and other members of the care team.
* Follow up on referrals, medications, laboratory testing, appointments, hospital or emergency department visits, and other outstanding care needs.
* Help patients overcome barriers that interfere with treatment.
* Escalate clinical concerns promptly to the appropriate licensed clinician.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of care\-management activities.
* Track time and services accurately according to established Principal Care Management workflows.
* Maintain patient registries, tracking lists, and follow\-up queues.
* Work closely with providers and leadership to identify patients who may benefit from higher levels of treatment or additional services.
* Participate in team huddles and performance reviews.
* Protect patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA and organizational policies at all times.

Your Scorecard

Success in this position will be measured—not guessed.

You will be expected to demonstrate:

* High percentage of eligible patients successfully contacted.
* Strong patient enrollment and engagement.
* Timely completion of assigned follow\-ups.
* Minimal patients lost to follow\-up.
* Accurate and complete documentation.
* Appropriate escalation of clinical concerns.
* Closed\-loop communication with providers and other members of the care team.
* Consistent achievement of departmental productivity and quality goals.
* Positive patient experience.
* Reliability, attendance, and ownership of results.

Minimum Qualifications

* **Associate or Bachelor’s degree** in Healthcare Management, Health Administration, Behavioral Health, Public Health, or a closely related healthcare field.
* At least 2–3 years of experience working in a medical, behavioral health, care management, or healthcare coordination setting preferred.
* Strong telephone and patient communication skills.
* Excellent organizational and follow\-through abilities.
* Comfort working with electronic health records and multiple technology platforms.
* Strong written communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage a large number of patients and tasks without losing attention to detail.
* Ability to recognize when an issue needs to be escalated to a clinician.

We Would Especially Like to Meet You If You Have

* Psychiatry or behavioral health experience.
* Care management, chronic care management, population health, or patient navigation experience.
* Experience communicating with primary care offices and specialists.
* Experience with eClinicalWorks or a similar EHR.
* Experience working with insurance authorization or healthcare documentation.
* Bilingual capability.

Who Will Thrive Here

Our strongest team members do more than complete tasks. They take ownership.

At MD TruCare, our **I\-TRUST values** guide how we work:

**Innovation \& Excellence** — We continually look for a better way.

**Trustworthiness** — Patients and teammates can depend on us.

**Respect** — We treat every patient and colleague with dignity.

**Unwavering Integrity \& Accountability** — We do what we say we will do and take responsibility for results.

**Service with Compassion** — We remember that every task represents a person who needs our help.

**Teamwork** — We communicate, collaborate, and solve problems together.

If your first reaction when something goes wrong is *“Who should I tell?”* rather than *“How can I help solve this?”*, this position will probably not be the right fit.

If you naturally take ownership, follow through until the loop is closed, and care about getting measurable results for patients, you may thrive here.

Why Join MD TruCare?

We are building an organization designed to become one of the leading behavioral health and interventional psychiatry practices in North Texas.

This position offers the opportunity to join a growing organization where high performers can take on increasing responsibility as the organization expands.

You will work alongside psychiatrists, advanced practice providers, therapists, clinical staff, and operational leaders who are committed to improving how psychiatric care is delivered.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief response to the following question:

**Tell us about a time when a patient, customer, or important task could easily have fallen through the cracks. What did you personally do to make sure it was completed?**

We are less interested in perfect resumes than we are in finding people who demonstrate **ownership, intelligence, compassion, and follow\-through**.

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Education:** Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Management, Health Administration, Behavioral Health, Public Health, or a closely related healthcare field.

**Experience:** Healthcare or care coordination experience preferred.

MD TruCare is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $41,000\.00 \- $46,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Ergonomic Specialist - San Francisco Bay Area - On-Site - Full-Time
jobs.description:
**Ergonomics Specialist**

**Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Ergonomics Specialist to provide comprehensive ergonomic services throughout the San Francisco Bay Area. This role requires a minimum of five years of professional ergonomics experience and demonstrated expertise performing both office and industrial ergonomic evaluations.

The Ergonomics Specialist will provide high\-quality ergonomic services that help clients proactively identify and reduce musculoskeletal risk. The position is intended for an experienced ergonomics professional capable of independently evaluating both office and industrial environments, developing practical solutions, and serving as a trusted ergonomic resource to employees and organizational leadership.

The Ergonomics Specialist will work directly with a variety of environments assessing job tasks, ergonomic risk factors, and develop practical recommendations that reduce workplace injuries.

The ideal candidate is an experienced professional who can independently assess a wide range of work environments, communicate effectively with employees and leadership, and provide evidence\-based ergonomic recommendations that are practical, defensible, and operationally appropriate.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Office Ergonomics**

* Conduct comprehensive office ergonomic evaluations for employees working in traditional office, hybrid, remote, and specialized workstation environments.
* Develop practical recommendations involving engineering controls, administrative controls, equipment modifications, task redesign, and improved work practices.
* Evaluate workstation setup, seating, monitor placement, keyboard and mouse positioning, work surfaces, accessories, lighting, and employee work practices.
* Educate employees regarding proper workstation setup, neutral positioning, movement strategies, and healthy work habits.
* Provide appropriate recommendations for chairs, input devices, monitor solutions, sit\-stand equipment, accessories, and workstation modifications.
* Prepare clear, professional ergonomic evaluation reports and recommendations.

**Industrial Ergonomics**

* Perform ergonomic assessments in industrial, manufacturing, warehouse, healthcare, laboratory, material\-handling, and other physically demanding work environments.
* Analyze work processes, equipment, tools, workstation design, and employee work methods.
* Evaluate proposed equipment, workplace modifications, and ergonomic interventions when requested.
* Conduct follow\-up assessments to determine effectiveness of implemented recommendations.

**Ergonomic Assessment Expertise**

* The Ergonomics Specialist must be capable of independently selecting and applying appropriate ergonomic assessment methodologies based on the task being evaluated.
* Experience with recognized assessment tools and methodologies may include:
* Various Lifting Evaluations, REBA, RULA, Strain Index, LMMMHT, and additional materials handling assessments.
* The specialist must also be able to interpret assessment findings and translate technical ergonomic information into practical recommendations.

**Client Consultation and Communication**

* Serve as a professional ergonomic resource to employees, supervisors, managers, Safety/EHS professionals, and client leadership.
* Communicate ergonomic findings clearly and objectively.
* Explain ergonomic risks and make recommendations in a manner that is understandable to both employees and management.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to develop practical solutions that balance employee safety, operational requirements, productivity, and cost.
* Present ergonomic findings and recommendations to management and leadership when appropriate.
* Identify significant ergonomic concerns and communicate them through established escalation processes.
* Maintain a professional, consultative presence at all client locations.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of five years of professional ergonomics experience.
* Demonstrated experience independently performing both office and industrial ergonomic assessments.
* Strong knowledge of ergonomic principles, biomechanics, human anatomy, and musculoskeletal risk factors.
* Experience evaluating physically demanding job tasks including lifting, pushing, pulling, carrying, repetitive work, and awkward postures.
* Ability to independently identify ergonomic hazards and develop appropriate corrective recommendations.
* Strong understanding of engineering controls, administrative controls, and work\-practice interventions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong client\-facing and consultative skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees, supervisors, managers, Safety/EHS professionals, and executive leadership.
* Ability to work independently and exercise sound professional judgment.
* Strong documentation and report\-writing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple client needs, assessments, and priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic documentation systems.
* Ability to travel throughout the San Francisco Bay Area to client locations.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in one of the following or a closely related discipline is preferred: Ergonomics, Human Factors, Industrial Engineering, or another related field.
* Equivalent education combined with extensive professional ergonomics experience may be considered.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Professional Ergonomist (CPE), Associate Ergonomics Professional (AEP), or equivalent ergonomics credential.

jobs.title: Benefits Specialist
jobs.description:
At Project HOME, every role contributes to our mission of empowering individuals to achieve stability, wellness, and self\-determination. As a Benefits Specialist, you'll help patients overcome barriers to healthcare by connecting them with insurance coverage, financial assistance, medications, specialty care, and other essential resources.



You'll work directly with patients to navigate Medicaid, Marketplace, Medicare, Project HOME's sliding fee program, and other benefits while helping ensure accurate coverage information and supporting the financial sustainability of our Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC).



If you enjoy helping people navigate complex systems, solving problems, and providing compassionate, hands\-on support, we'd love to hear from you.


**Location:** Stephen Klein Wellness Center, 2144 Cecil B. Moore Avenue, Philadelphia, PA 19121  

**Schedule:** Monday\-Friday \| 9:00 AM\-5:00 PM \| Fully onsite  

**Compensation:** $23\.00/hour


**What You'll Do**
==================


**Help Patients Access Benefits \& Coverage**
---------------------------------------------


* Help patients understand and access Medicaid, Marketplace, Medicare, supplemental Medicare, and other available health coverage.
* Screen uninsured patients for coverage options and assist with completing and submitting applications, including through Pennsylvania COMPASS.
* Manage Project HOME sliding fee applications, ensuring information is accurately entered in eClinicalWorks (eCW) and updated as required.
* Explain sliding fee eligibility and requirements to patients in a clear and supportive way.

**Support Access to Healthcare**

* Provide Patient Services Representative and Medical/Dental Reception coverage during breaks, absences, and other operational needs.


**What You'll Need**
====================


* Bachelor's degree **or** relevant experience in an FQHC, health center, benefits navigation, or similar setting.
* Knowledge of Medicaid insurance applications through the Pennsylvania COMPASS system.
* Experience navigating benefits, insurance, healthcare, government assistance, or similar systems.
* Strong oral and written communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to analyze information, manage competing priorities, work under pressure, and adapt to changing needs.
* Comfort using electronic systems, spreadsheets, and documentation tools accurately and consistently.
* Ability to work effectively and compassionately with individuals experiencing barriers to healthcare.


**What You May Bring**

* Experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW), Epic, or another EHR/EMR system.
* Experience with Medicaid, Medicare, Marketplace coverage, insurance eligibility, or public benefits.
* Previous experience in an FQHC, healthcare, social services, case management, or residential services environment.
* Experience with trauma\-informed care, motivational interviewing, crisis de\-escalation, or conflict management.

**What We Offer**

Project HOME is committed to supporting the well\-being of our employees through a comprehensive benefits package.

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance with low employee costs
* Company\-paid life and disability insurance

jobs.title: Lead Nurse Practitioner, Women's Health
jobs.description:
**About Gabbi**

Breast cancer touches nearly all of us — personally, through someone we love, or through our communities. By age 50, many women will have been close to someone diagnosed, or faced that diagnosis themselves. In 2026, women should not be dying of breast cancer. At Gabbi, we're on a mission to make late\-stage breast cancer obsolete.

Early detection is everything. Women diagnosed at stage 0 or stage 1 have a 99% survival rate; women diagnosed at stage 4 have an approximately 30% survival rate.

The challenge is that too many women don't know their risk — so they don't know what care they need or when to seek it. Gabbi changes that. We start with a comprehensive, evidence\-based risk assessment that helps women understand their individualized risk. From there, we provide a personalized action plan and real\-time care navigation, supported by our clinical breast specialists, to help women access the right care at the right time.

We envision a world where every woman knows her risk — and we won't stop until we get there. At Gabbi, we save lives. We hope you'll join us.

**In this role, you will be responsible for:**

This role begins at 20 hours per week of administrative time plus 5 hours per week of clinical practice, with the goal of growing into a full\-time position where clinical time makes up 50–75% of your weekly hours based on business needs. It's a contract\-to\-hire opportunity. This is a great opportunity to play a pivotal role in building out the clinical team at Gabbi and helping us save even more women's lives!

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Leadership \& Operations*

* Lead interviewing and onboarding for every new provider, from first conversation to first day of practice
* Lead monthly APP meetings that keep the clinical team aligned, updated on the latest clinical guidelines, and ensure metrics are being met
* Help implement new clinical initiatives
* Conduct chart audits and other provider quality assurance to ensure consistency in quality of care
* Own the relationship with the collaborating physician (CP) once the CP and APP are fully onboarded
* Serve as the point of escalation for clinical questions across the care team
* Work with Clinical Operations, Product \& Engineering, Partner Success Managers, and Clinical Liaison to streamline provider and patient experience
* Partner with the care coordination team to keep patient care seamless and every result accounted for and communicated to patients
* Coach providers to maintain a 90% follow\-up rate for high\- and increased\-risk patients
* Develop clear, compelling case studies to share with clinical partners
* Build trust with providers across our partner networks to strengthen the relationship and improve the experience of referring providers
* Manage provider schedules and 1099 payments to keep operations running smoothly
* Manage provider time off and coverage to ensure patients are never without care
* Partner with Medical Directors to keep clinical protocols current and evidence\-based

*Clinical Care*

* Deliver care 100% remotely via secure telehealth
* Own clinical KPIs to ensure providers are meeting the following metrics:
* 90% of high and increased risk patients complete a follow\-up appointment
* Communication of abnormal imaging results within 24 hours
* Note completion within 24 hours
* \>95% of audited charts meeting internal standards
* Provider NPS \> 90
* Additional KPIs developed with Clinical Operations
* Practice with autonomy in a team\-based model — operating independently while collaborating with physicians and clinical partners when escalation or specialty input is needed
* Deliver clinical excellence in a startup environment
* Follow evidence\-based protocols, keep meticulous documentation, and help improve workflows as we scale

**Qualifications**

* APRN licensed in CT and NJ; at least one additional active license in FL, GA, ID, IL, MN, NJ, TX, VA, or WI
* Experience in women's health preferred
* Prior leadership experience supervising, mentoring, or managing clinical staff
* At least 5 years of clinical experience as a Nurse Practitioner
* Experience operating as an independent provider, eligible for practice autonomy
* Professional and emotionally intelligent in a high\-trust, small\-team setting
* Telehealth experience strongly preferred
* Multiple state NP licenses strongly preferred; willingness to obtain additional state licenses required

**Who You Are**

* Thrive in a fast\-paced environment and adapt quickly as priorities shift
* Comfortable building while doing — you will be responsible for creating, testing, and refining clinical workflows and patient experiences while staying grounded in evidence\-based care
* Able to see the big picture, but willing to jump in the weeds to figure out the root of an issue in order to improve workflows
* A natural leader — you know how to engage and manage providers; you are energized by growing other providers, not just supervising them; comfortable giving direct feedback and having hard conversations when performance slips
* Highly self\-directed — you take initiative, own outcomes, and follow through with minimal oversight; you are a quick learner and able to troubleshoot on your own
* Energized by cross\-functional work with ops, product, engineering, and member experience teams to improve care delivery
* Eager to learn, iterate, and improve through data, feedback, and coaching
* Mission\-driven, with a patient\-first approach and a desire to rethink how breast health care is delivered
* Committed to staying current on NCCN guidelines for breast cancer early detection and prevention
* A strong communicator who is clear, direct, warm, and able to effectively communicate these traits both in writing and in a virtual\-first environment

**Compensation and Benefits:**

This is an incredible opportunity to help build out the clinical team at a venture\-backed, early stage startup. You will work side by side with the CEO and Gabbi's clinical leadership to shape how care is delivered. Your goal is to help us bring Gabbi's vision to every woman — we can't do it without you!

* $66–68/hour
* A full\-time conversion comes with medical and dental benefits and equity

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

The responsibilities and duties of this position described here are representative of those an employee must perform. This is not a comprehensive list and other duties may be assigned.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity ("EEO") Employer. It has been and will continue to be a fundamental policy of Gabbi not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, partnership status, domestic violence victim status, sexual orientation, age, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, unemployment status or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state and/or local laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, compensation, training, working conditions, transfer, job assignments, benefits, layoff, and termination.

Pay: $66\.00 \- $68\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**Youth Mentor \& Behavioral Health Specialist**

Project Patch Youth Program – Garden Valley, Idaho


* Affordable on\-site housing available!
* $40,000\-$50,000 annual compensation, including scheduled overtime
* Full\-time day shift, Pitman schedule
* No experience required; paid training provided
* Medical, Dental, Vision \& Retirement Benefits
* Eligible for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)


Project Patch is seeking dependable, compassionate, and steady Youth Mentors to provide supervision, behavioral support, mentorship, and positive role modeling for adolescents ages 12\-17\.



This position is ideal for individuals seeking meaningful, hands\-on work and valuable experience in behavioral health, social work, psychology, education, youth ministry, law enforcement, or other human services fields. Through daily mentorship, support, and guidance, Youth Mentors help adolescents build stability, develop healthy coping skills, strengthen accountability, and move toward lasting positive change. No professional license is required, and Project Patch provides all required training and certifications.

**About Project Patch**



Project Patch is a nonprofit, Christian residential treatment center serving adolescents ages 12–17 who are experiencing behavioral, emotional, or relational challenges and benefit from a structured therapeutic environment. The program is licensed by the State of Idaho for up to 40 clients and employs approximately 40 staff members in a mission\-driven, faith\-based environment focused on trauma\-informed, relationship\-centered care. Our mission is to restore hope and direction through Christ\-centered residential care.


**Location \& Lifestyle**



Our campus is located in the mountains of Garden Valley, Idaho, approximately one hour north of Boise. The area offers a scenic outdoor environment with year\-round recreation, a quiet and close\-knit community setting, and the opportunity to live and work in a mission\-focused environment. Affordable on\-site staff housing may be available.


**Schedule**



Full\-time day shift using a Pitman\-style schedule: 2 days on, 2 days off, and 3 days on, 3 days off with alternating weekends and holidays. This schedule includes built\-in overtime that increases total earnings.


**Benefits**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance effective within 90 days of hire


* Retirement benefits with employer match from date of hire


* Competitive hourly pay


* Paid Time Off within 90 days of hire


* Sick time accrues from date of hire


* Eligible for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)


* Ongoing paid training and professional development


* Affordable on\-site staff housing may be available depending on current availability.


**Minimum Qualifications**


* High school diploma or equivalent required


* Minimum age of 19 at time of hire


* Experience working with youth, behavioral health, education, or residential care is preferred but not required


* No professional license is required for this position


* Strong interpersonal skills, maturity, reliability, and a desire to work with adolescents in a structured environment


**Required Certifications and Training**



Project Patch provides all required training and certifications at no cost to employees, including CPR and First Aid, crisis prevention and de\-escalation training, medication administration training, mandated reporter training, and trauma\-informed care training including Trust\-Based Relational Intervention® (TBRI®)


**Essential Functions**


* Maintain supervision to support youth safety


* Implement behavior support plans and individualized care strategies


* Respond to behavioral crises using approved de\-escalation techniques


* Complete accurate documentation, incident reports, and shift notes


* Administer medications after completing required training and according to policy


* Collaborate with clinicians, supervisors, and team members


* Engage youth in daily programming, including recreation, education, and therapeutic activities


* Model healthy relationships, boundaries, and decision\-making


**Additional Responsibilities**


* Assist with group facilitation and therapeutic activities


* Support daily residential operations, including meals, transportation, and routines


* Participate in staff meetings, training, and supervision


* Help maintain a structured, safe, and supportive environment


**Trauma\-Informed Care Expectations**



Staff are expected to remain calm and regulated during stress or conflict, use empathy, consistency, and choice\-based interventions, avoid power struggles, support emotional regulation, and apply trauma\-informed principles including TBRI® strategies.


**Faith**



Project Patch is a Christian organization that integrates faith into daily programming. Employees support and model conduct consistent with Christian values and provide mentorship aligned with the organization’s mission.


**Physical \& Environmental Requirements**


* Ability to stand, walk, and remain alert for extended periods


* Ability to participate in outdoor and physically active recreation


* Ability to intervene physically when necessary in accordance with training and policy


* Ability to work in a residential environment, including occasional extended shifts


**Professional Conduct**


* Maintain appropriate boundaries with youth at all times


* Adhere to ethical, legal, and organizational standards


* Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team


**Core Competencies**



Youth mentorship and relationship\-building; behavioral intervention and crisis response; emotional regulation support; trauma\-informed care practices; clear communication and documentation; teamwork and reliability.


**Who Thrives in This Role**



This position is ideal for individuals who stay calm and consistent under pressure, value structure, accountability, and teamwork, enjoy working with adolescents, feel called to serve in a faith\-based environment, and are seeking experience in behavioral health or human services. This role may be a good fit for future counselors, social workers, teachers, ministry leaders, law enforcement professionals, or others interested in youth development and behavioral health.

Project Patch is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, or any other protected status.

jobs.title: Certified Therapeutic Recreation Specialist - PRN
jobs.description:
At Oceans Behavioral Hospital Baton Rouge, healing is our focus. We are passionate about helping adults and seniors manage the challenges associated with anxiety, depression and other mental health issues. Utilizing proven, innovative and progressive therapies, our qualified professionals strive to promote long\-term wellness through a range of inpatient and outpatient psychiatric counseling and treatment options.



The Certified Therapeutic Recreation Specialist (CTRS), provides assessment, individualized intervention planning, treatment planning and group therapy to further patient/family/group progress in treatment according to Joint Commission, Federal and State Regulations, the Oceans' Mission, policies and procedures and Performance Improvement standards.

  


Essential Functions:


* Provides direct therapeutic recreation therapy services in accordance with accepted standards of therapeutic recreation practice in a timely fashion as outlined by Joint Commission, Federal and State Regulations, and the Hospital's Mission statement and CQI monitors.


* Plans and conducts individual and group therapy as assigned by physician's order.


* Completes all necessary paperwork/documents within 72 hours of admission. (Conducts, assesses and interprets completion of Comprehensive Integrated Assessment, reviews all multidisciplinary assessments and compiles a Multidisciplinary Treatment Integration under the supervision of the attending physician.


* Performs chart audits of the recreational activities provided to patients.


* Participates as an active member of the treatment team, attending meetings and reporting on assigned patients and progress toward treatment goals.


* Documents in a timely manner in the medical record the services rendered.


* Communicates in an age/disability/culturally sensitive related manner to patients and their families and identifies safety, psychosocial, special mobility and special equipment needs.


* Conducts treatments and discharge planning in accordance with age/disability/cultural needs, and involving members of the patient's support system in decision making as appropriate.


* Develops, plans and provides in\-services for inter/intra \- community/staff on a minimum of a bi\-annual basis.


* Performs other duties and projects as assigned.



**Requirements**


Bachelor's degree and CTRS license and maintain yearly certification. Prefer three (3\) years experience clinical practice in inpatient acute care and one\-year supervisory experience.


Demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to any age\-related, disability\-related needs of the patients served on assignment. Demonstrate knowledge of the principles of growth and development appropriate to the patient population served. Able to assess and interpret data about the patient’s status in order to identify each patient’s needs and provide the appropriate care, including age related care/disability/cultural sensitivity related care to adolescent, chronically mentally ill, adult, geriatric, chemically dependent, and dually diagnosed patient populations. Demonstrate in\-depth knowledge of mental illness and chemical dependency and the family dynamics, which accompany them. Must have basic knowledge of chronic mental illness. Have in\-depth knowledge of clinical therapy modalities. Have excellent communication and group/process skills as related to age specific patient needs. Be versatile, flexible and able to perform in stressful situations. Have good time management and organization skills. Be capable of coordinating multi\-faceted workload. Must be able to work under close supervision. Must successfully complete CPR certification and an Oceans approved behavioral de\-escalation program.


Subject to many interruptions. Pressure due to multiple calls and inquiries. This position can be high paced and stressful; must be able to cope mentally and physically to atmosphere. This person might sometimes experience disagreeable odors, sights and/or unpredictable patient behavior. Work requires spending approximately 90% or more of the time inside a building that offers protection from weather conditions but not necessarily from temperature changes.

jobs.title: Direct Care Specialist/ Youth Mentor
jobs.description:
Job Description

The **Direct Care Specialist / Youth Mentor** provides direct supervision, support, guidance, and mentorship to young men residing at Rapha House Transitional Home for Boys. The position is responsible for helping maintain a safe, structured, supportive residential environment while assisting residents in developing the life skills, responsibility, confidence, and independence needed to successfully transition into adulthood.

Essential Duties \& Responsibilities

* Provide direct supervision and support to residents during assigned shifts.
* Serve as a consistent, positive adult role model and mentor.
* Maintain appropriate professional boundaries with all residents.
* Help residents follow daily schedules, household expectations, curfews, and program rules.
* Assist residents in developing independent\-living skills, including cooking, cleaning, laundry, budgeting, organization, time management, and personal responsibility.
* Support residents' educational, employment, vocational, and personal\-development goals.
* Transport residents to approved appointments, school, work, activities, and other destinations as assigned.
* Encourage healthy communication, decision\-making, conflict resolution, and problem\-solving.
* Use approved crisis\-prevention and de\-escalation techniques when necessary.
* Respond appropriately to emergencies and follow all safety and emergency procedures.
* Observe resident behavior, progress, needs, and concerns and communicate significant changes to appropriate supervisory staff.
* Complete shift notes, incident reports, logs, and other required documentation accurately and on time.
* Participate in shift\-change communication to ensure continuity of care.
* Follow each resident's individualized service or transitional\-living plan as applicable.
* Assist with medication\-related procedures in accordance with program policy, training, and applicable requirements.
* Maintain resident confidentiality and protect private information.
* Report suspected abuse or neglect in accordance with Louisiana mandated\-reporting requirements.
* Participate in staff meetings, orientation, training, and professional development.
* Maintain required CPR, First Aid, and other certifications or training.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and supportive residential environment.
* Follow all policies and procedures of Rapha House and The Willie Whitehead Foundation.
* Perform other reasonable duties related to resident care, safety, and program operations as assigned.

Pay: $12\.00 \- $15\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Shift Details:** **Monday \-Friday, 4:30pm\-1am**

**Who We Are**
--------------

**At Framebridge, we are disrupting the custom framing market by replacing a cumbersome experience with a delightful one. Our mission is to make framing so delightful, customers are inspired to frame everything they love—big, little and in between. We've framed over three million pieces and counting. We are building a beloved brand, and to be successful, we have to build a great team across a number of disciplines – ecommerce, retail, design, and manufacturing.**

**We are a consumer business operating online and in our growing fleet of retail stores. We operate multiple manufacturing studios that allow us to deliver a high\-quality custom product at an affordable price with a quick turnaround. We exist, grow, and ultimately own the market by delighting customers who trust and value us.**

**The Role**
------------

**As an Art Tech you will play a crucial role in the custom framing process. You will use custom technology to read and receive orders from our customers and ensure that we have accurate measurements, color and style selections, and all the information required to create the customer’s vision for their unique pieces. You will be responsible for applying hardware to assembled picture and art frames and responsible for conducting final quality checks to ensure customer satisfaction. Each order is custom and so you will need great attention to detail since no two pieces of art are alike! Working closely with team members you will collaborate to meet production goals and oversee the entire lifecycle of customer pieces, from work order completion to mounting, assembly, and final quality control. Your duties include securely affixing paintings, photographs, or prints onto support surfaces for framing, as well as meticulously assembling various components of the artwork.**

**As a Framebridge Team Member, You Will:**
-------------------------------------------

**Show Pride**

**We stand behind our work, we sweat the details, and we strive for continuous improvement every day. We’re proud to frame the things you love, and show pride in our product and craftsmanship.**

**Adapt \& Act**
